|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account identifier.|
|whitelisted_address_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The whitelisted address update travel rule information for|
|body|body|[UpdateWhitelistedAddressTravelRuleInfoRequest](#schemaupdatewhitelistedaddresstravelruleinforequest)|true|Travel rule information to associate with the whitelisted address.|
|» travel_rule_info|body|[TravelRuleInfo](#schematravelruleinfo)|true|Travel rule information pertaining to the wallet being whitelisted. Identify the destination by providing beneficiary_vasp_id, setting beneficiary_is_self_hosted to true, or providing beneficiary_manual_entry. ## Search for VASPs

<a id="opIdsearchVASPs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/wallets/travel-rule/vasps \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/wallets/travel-rule/vasps`

Search for Virtual Asset Service Providers, or crypto exchanges, on Notabene's network.
This endpoint can be used to find the VASP DID for your beneficiary's exchange when submitting
travel rule information for your whitelisted wallets. Use the `q` parameter to search for exchanges.

<h3 id="search-for-vasps-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|General search query string.|
|emailDomain|query|string|false|Filter by VASP email domain.|
|chainalysisName|query|string|false|Filter by Chainalysis-specific VASP name.|
|fields|query|string|false|Specify which fields to return (comma-separated).|
|page|query|integer|false|The zero-based page number to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items per page.|
|order|query|string|false|Field-based sort expression, such as name:ASC. Multiple expressions may be comma-separated. Defaults to name:ASC.|
|includeSubsidiaryVASPs|query|boolean|false|Whether to include child/subsidiary entities.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "pages": 1,
  "total": 1,
  "vasps": [
    {
      "country": "US",
      "did": "did:ethr:0xf1c002f9e7ca88018d6dcf1e86403fb2f5f055f4",
      "id": "vasp-1",
      "name": "Example Exchange"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="search-for-vasps-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful request. `vasps` lists each match and is an empty array when nothing matches.|[SearchVASPsResponse](#schemasearchvaspsresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth
</aside>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/fpsl/analytics/{account_id}/loans`

Returns aggregated FPSL interest and loan-activity counts for one account over a date range. Use this for "earned so far this month" customer UIs and for supervisory spot-checks against your internal accrual model.

The `{account_id}` path parameter accepts a account UUID (aggregation for that account).

<h3 id="read-fpsl-loans-analytics-for-an-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The account identifier (account UUID).|
|start|query|string(date)|false|Filter loans after or on this start date (inclusive). Defaults to the first day of the current month, New York timezone.|
|end|query|string(date)|false|Filter loans before this end date (exclusive). Defaults to the day after the current date, New York timezone.|

|end|query|string(date)|false|Filter loans before this end date.|
|page_token|query|string|false|The pagination token used to continue retrieving results. This value is returned in certain responses when additional data is available, typically due to a response size limit.|
|limit|query|integer|false|The maximum number of data points to return in the response page.|

## Confirm Tokenized Asset Minted

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/tokenization/callback/mint`

This endpoint is used by the issuer to confirm the minting of tokenized assets previously requested by the Authorized Participant.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "client_account_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|» client_account_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Alpaca account ID (UUID) of the Authorized Participant. Exactly one of `client_external_account_id` or `client_account_id` must be provided, matching the identifier used on the original mint request. The deprecated `client_id` field is still accepted as an alias for `client_external_account_id` during the deprecation window.|

The deprecated `client_id` field is still accepted as an alias for `client_external_account_id` during the deprecation window.|

## Redeem a Tokenized Asset

<a id="opIdpostTokenizationRedeem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/accounts/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/tokenization/callback/redeem \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "client_account_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "client_external_account_id": "string",
    "issuer_request_id": "string",
    "network": "solana",
    "qty": "string",
    "token_symbol": "string",
    "tx_hash": "string",
    "underlying_symbol": "string",
    "wallet_address": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/tokenization/callback/redeem`

This endpoint is used by the tokenized asset issuer to confirm the redemption of tokens previously held in the Authorized Participant's wallet. When the issuer invokes this endpoint, Alpaca will  initiate a journal of the underlying asset into the Authorized Participant's account.

**Idempotency**: When the `Idempotency-Key` header is supplied, this endpoint is
idempotent. Multiple requests with the same key and identical request body will
create only one redeem request. A subsequent request returns the previously created
request with the same response (no duplicate is created). If the same key is used
with a different request body, the API returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.

**Recommended for production**: Always supply `Idempotency-Key` when requesting a
redemption. This allows safe retries on timeouts, network errors, or 5xx responses
without risking duplicate requests. Use a client-generated unique value (e.g. UUID).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "client_account_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "client_external_account_id": "string",
  "issuer_request_id": "string",
  "network": "solana",
  "qty": "string",
  "token_symbol": "string",
  "tx_hash": "string",
  "underlying_symbol": "string",
  "wallet_address": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="redeem-a-tokenized-asset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account identifier.|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional client-generated key for safe retries and duplicate request detection.<br>This endpoint currently accepts keys up to 128 characters. Alpaca is moving toward<br>a 36-character maximum; new implementations should generate a unique UUIDv7 or<br>UUIDv4 value (36 characters including hyphens) for each logical operation. Do not<br>reuse a key across operations.<br>|
|body|body|[TokenizationRedeemRequest](#schematokenizationredeemrequest)|true|none|
|» client_account_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Alpaca account ID (UUID) of the Authorized Participant. Exactly one of `client_external_account_id` or `client_account_id` must be provided to identify the Authorized Participant whose account will receive the underlying asset. The deprecated `client_id` field is still accepted as an alias for `client_external_account_id` during the deprecation window.|
|» client_external_account_id|body|string|false|Customer's client identifier on the issuer's platform. Exactly one of `client_external_account_id` or `client_account_id` must be provided to identify the Authorized Participant whose account will receive the underlying asset. The deprecated `client_id` field is still accepted as an alias for `client_external_account_id` during the deprecation window.|
|» issuer_request_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier of the redemption request set by the issuer|
|» network|body|[TokenizationNetwork](#schematokenizationnetwork)|true|The token's blockchain network|
|» qty|body|string|true|The quantity to convert into the underlying asset. It can be fractional.|
|» token_symbol|body|string|true|The tokenized asset symbol|
|» tx_hash|body|string|true|Transaction hash of the completed request on the blockchain|
|» underlying_symbol|body|string|true|The underlying asset symbol|
|» wallet_address|body|string|true|The address where the redeemed tokens were originally held|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» network|arbitrum|
|» network|base|
|» network|binance|
|» network|cronos|
|» network|ethereum|
|» network|hypercore|
|» network|hyperevm|
|» network|mantle|
|» network|robinhood|
|» network|solana|
|» network|ton|
|» network|tron|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "issuer": "xstocks",
  "issuer_request_id": "string",
  "network": "solana",
  "qty": "string",
  "status": "completed",
  "token_symbol": "string",
  "tokenization_request_id": "string",
  "tx_hash": "string",
  "type": "mint",
  "underlying_symbol": "string",
  "wallet_address": "string"
}
```

```json
  "message": "failed to decode request body"

```

```json
{
  "code": 40110000,
  "message": "unauthorized"
}
```

```json
{
  "code": 40310000,
  "message": "forbidden"
}
```

```json
{
  "code": 42210001,
  "message": "issuer_request_id is required, tx_hash is required"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Successfully requested redemption of a tokenized asset.|[TokenizationRedeemResponse](#schematokenizationredeemresponse)|

## Mint a Tokenized Asset

<a id="opIdpostTokenizationMintBroker"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/accounts/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/tokenization/mint \

  }'
```

`POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/tokenization/mint`

This endpoint is used by an Authorized Participant to request the minting of a tokenized asset. Alpaca will initiate a journal of the underlying asset from the Authorized Participant's account to the issuer's account.

**Idempotency**: When the `Idempotency-Key` header is supplied, this endpoint is
idempotent. Multiple requests with the same key and identical request body will
create only one mint request. A subsequent request returns the previously created
request with the same response (no duplicate is created). If the same key is used
with a different request body, the API returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.

**Recommended for production**: Always supply `Idempotency-Key` when requesting a
mint. This allows safe retries on timeouts, network errors, or 5xx responses
without risking duplicate requests. Use a client-generated unique value (e.g. UUID).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "issuer": "xstocks",
  "network": "solana",
  "qty": "string",
  "underlying_symbol": "string",
  "wallet_address": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account identifier.|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional client-generated key for safe retries and duplicate request detection.<br>This endpoint currently accepts keys up to 128 characters. Alpaca is moving toward<br>a 36-character maximum; new implementations should generate a unique UUIDv7 or<br>UUIDv4 value (36 characters including hyphens) for each logical operation. Do not<br>reuse a key across operations.<br>|
|body|body|[TokenizationMintRequest](#schematokenizationmintrequest)|true|none|
|» issuer|body|[TokenizationIssuer](#schematokenizationissuer)|true|The tokenized asset's issuer|
|» network|body|[TokenizationNetwork](#schematokenizationnetwork)|true|The token's blockchain network|
|» qty|body|string|true|The underlying quantity to convert into the tokenized asset. It can be fractional.|
|» underlying_symbol|body|string|true|The underlying asset symbol|
|» wallet_address|body|string|true|The wallet address to receive the tokenized asset|

## List Tokenization Requests

<a id="opIdgetTokenizationRequestsBroker"></a>

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/accounts/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/tokenization/requests \

```

`GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/tokenization/requests`

Retrieve tokenization requests for the account. This endpoint may be used by the tokenized asset issuer or by an Authorized Participant (AP). The list can contain both mint and redeem requests.

<h3 id="list-tokenization-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account identifier.|
|type|query|string|false|Tokenization request type to be queried|
|status|query|string|false|Tokenization request status to be queried|
|underlying_symbol|query|string|false|Underlying symbol of the tokenization requests to be queried|
|issuer|query|[TokenizationIssuer](#schematokenizationissuer)|false|Issuer of the tokenization requests to be queried|
|network|query|[TokenizationNetwork](#schematokenizationnetwork)|false|Network of the tokenization requests to be queried|
|after|query|string(date-time)|false|The response will include only requests created after this timestamp (exclusive)|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|The response will include only requests created before this timestamp (exclusive)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

## Get Tokenization Request by `client_request_id`

<a id="opIdgetTokenizationRequestByClientRequestIDBroker"></a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/tokenization/requests:by_client_request_id`

Retrieve a single tokenization request by the Authorized Participant's `client_request_id`, the AP-supplied label originally passed on the mint request. Available to Authorized Participants and to issuers that are affiliated with the AP. Returns the matching mint request. If the AP has reused a `client_request_id` across multiple requests, the most recently created request is returned.

<h3 id="get-tokenization-request-by-clientrequestid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account identifier.|
|client_request_id|query|string|true|AP-supplied request identifier originally passed on the mint request, echoed back on the tokenization-request response.|

<h1 id="broker-api-acats">ACATS</h1>

Endpoints for initiating and tracking ACATS transfers. Use the ACATS endpoints to create transfers and query their current state, and the [Admin Action Events Stream](#operation/subscribeToAdminActionSSE) under the **Events** group to receive real-time status updates (`acats_status_admin_event`) as a transfer moves through its lifecycle.


## List transfers

<a id="opIdlistACATSTransfers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1beta1/acats \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1beta1/acats`

List all incoming and outgoing transfers, for all accounts. The list may include transfers not initiated using this API. The list is paginated: use the `page_token` query parameter with the value returned in the response to continue listing transfers.

<h3 id="list-transfers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_number|query|string|false|Filter by the account number associated with the transfer|
|transfer_type|query|[AcatsDtccTransferType](#schemaacatsdtcctransfertype)|false|Filter by the type of the transfer|
|transfer_direction|query|[AcatsTransferDirection](#schemaacatstransferdirection)|false|Filter by the direction of the transfer|
|transfer_status|query|[AcatsTransferStatus](#schemaacatstransferstatus)|false|Filter by the current status of the transfer|
|dtcc_status|query|[AcatsDtccStatus](#schemaacatsdtccstatus)|false|Filter by the current DTCC status of the transfer|
|contra_broker_number|query|string|false|Filter by the contra broker number of the transfer|
|since|query|[AcatsTimestamp](#schemaacatstimestamp)|false|List transfers created at or after this RFC-3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`).|
|until|query|[AcatsTimestamp](#schemaacatstimestamp)|false|List transfers created strictly before this RFC-3339 timestamp (exclusive -- e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z` excludes transfers created exactly at that instant).|
|sort_direction|query|[AcatsSortDirection](#schemaacatssortdirection)|false|Specify whether transfers should be sorted by creation time in ascending or descending order|
|sort_by|query|string|false|Specify the field to sort by. Defaults to `created_at`.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of transfers to return on one page|
|page_token|query|[AcatsPageToken](#schemaacatspagetoken)|false|Page token for the next or previous page, used to continue listing transfers|

## Initiate an incoming transfer

<a id="opIdrequestACATSTransfer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1beta1/acats/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "contra_account_details": {
      "account_number": "A00000123",
      "broker_number": "0158",
      "customer_name": "Jane Doe",
      "customer_tax_id": "123456789"
    },
    "ip_address": "203.0.113.42",
    "signed_at": "2026-04-29T13:00:00Z",
    "transfer_details": {
      "cash": [
        {
          "amount": "10000",
          "currency": "USD"
        }
      ],
      "securities": {
        "equities": [
          {
            "position": "LONG",
            "qty": "2",
            "symbol": "AAPL"
          },
          {
            "cusip": "123456789",
            "position": "LONG",
            "qty": "5"
          },
          {
            "position": "SHORT",
            "symbol": "TSLA"
          }
        ]
      },
      "type": "PARTIAL"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1beta1/acats/{account_id}`

This endpoint allows you to create new incoming ACATS requests. We currently support full and partial transfer types, for US equities and cash. Note that after submitting a request, it might take some time for the transfer to show up on the other endpoints. Transfers are not immediately sent to DTCC, and will appear in the `PENDING` state initially.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "contra_account_details": {
    "account_number": "A00000123",
    "broker_number": "0158",
    "customer_name": "Jane Doe",
    "customer_tax_id": "123456789"
  },
  "ip_address": "203.0.113.42",
  "signed_at": "2026-04-29T13:00:00Z",
  "transfer_details": {
    "cash": [
      {
        "amount": "10000",
        "currency": "USD"
      }
    ],
    "securities": {
      "equities": [
        {
          "position": "LONG",
          "qty": "2",
          "symbol": "AAPL"
        },
        {
          "cusip": "123456789",
          "position": "LONG",
          "qty": "5"
        },
        {
          "position": "SHORT",
          "symbol": "TSLA"
        }
      ]
    },
    "type": "PARTIAL"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="initiate-an-incoming-transfer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Account ID associated with the ACATS transfer|
|body|body|[AcatsInitiateTransferRequest](#schemaacatsinitiatetransferrequest)|true|Details of the incoming ACATS transfer to initiate.|
|» contra_account_details|body|[AcatsContraAccountDetails](#schemaacatscontraaccountdetails)|true|Contra account details|
|» ip_address|body|string|true|IP address from which the account holder initiated the transfer (IPv4 or IPv6)|
|» signed_at|body|string(date-time)|true|Timestamp at which the account holder signed/authorized the transfer. Must be within the last week and must not be in the future (a 5 minute grace period absorbs clock skew); values outside that window are rejected with HTTP 400.|
|» transfer_details|body|[AcatsInitiateTransferDetails](#schemaacatsinitiatetransferdetails)|true|Transfer details. The two transfer types are mutually exclusive in what they accept:<br>- `FULL`: do not include a non-empty `cash` or `securities.equities` array (the entire account will be transferred). Including either non-empty is rejected with HTTP 400.<br>- `PARTIAL`: specify which assets to transfer using the `cash` and/or `securities` objects. At least one of the two must be present and non-empty, otherwise the request is rejected with HTTP 400.<br>|
|» validate_account_number|body|boolean|false|Whether to validate the contra account number against the contra broker's configured format rules. Defaults to false (no per-broker format check). Set to true to opt in, in which case a number that matches none of the broker's enabled rules is rejected with HTTP 422.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "acats_id": "2c827687-ddd3-4ad9-bee8-0a3cdad35301"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "message": "contra broker number is required"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "message": "contra broker number is required"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "message": "contra broker number is required"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "message": "contra broker number is required"
}
```

<h3 id="initiate-an-incoming-transfer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|[AcatsInitiateTransferResponse](#schemaacatsinitiatetransferresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[AcatsError](#schemaacatserror)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[AcatsError](#schemaacatserror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity. Returned when:<br>- the cleansed contra account number contains no digit at all;<br>- `validate_account_number` is `true` and the contra account number matches none of the contra broker's enabled format rules;<br>- the calling correspondent is pending migration, in which case the account is treated as being in distribution.<br>|[AcatsError](#schemaacatserror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[AcatsError](#schemaacatserror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth
</aside>

`GET /v1beta1/acats/contrabrokers`

This information is provided based on the latest ACATS Participant Master File, and contains the DTCC account numbers of valid contra brokers. <h1 id="broker-api-ipo">IPO</h1>

Endpoints for discovering and tracking IPO (Initial Public Offering) lifecycle data. Use [`GET /v1/ipos`](#operation/listIPOOfferings) and [`GET /v1/ipos/{offering_reference}`](#operation/getIPOOffering) to query offerings on demand, and the [IPO Events Stream](#operation/subscribeToIPOEventsSSE) under the **Events** group to receive real-time and historical lifecycle updates (new offerings, prospectus, 60-minute mail, allocations, cancellations).


## List IPO Offerings

<a id="opIdlistIPOOfferings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/ipos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/ipos`

Returns a paginated list of IPO offerings currently known to Alpaca.

Use this endpoint to power IPO discovery surfaces (e.g. an "Upcoming IPOs" list). Real-time lifecycle changes (availability, prospectus, 60-minute mail, allocations, cancellations) are pushed over the [IPO Events Stream](#operation/subscribeToIPOEventsSSE).


<h3 id="list-ipo-offerings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|availability|query|string|false|Filter by offering availability.<br>- `available` - accepting new orders.<br>- `not_available` - not yet open for orders.<br>- `closed` - no longer accepting orders.<br>|
|ticker|query|string|false|Filter by ticker symbol (case-insensitive exact match).|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of offerings to return per page. Capped at `200`.|
|page_token|query|string|false|Opaque cursor returned in the previous response's `next_page_token` field. Pass it back to fetch the next page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|availability|available|
|availability|not_available|
|availability|closed|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "anticipated_shares": 5000000,
      "availability": "available",
      "cusip_id": "123456789",
      "description": "Example Corp is a leading provider of example services.",
      "ipo_reference": "FI111225",
      "logo_small": "https://example.com/logos/exmp-small.png",
      "max_price": "44",
      "max_ticket_size": "100000",
      "min_price": "40",
      "min_ticket_size": "100",
      "name": "Example Corp",
      "no_new_orders": false,
      "offering_type": "IPO",
      "prospectus_url": "https://example.com/prospectus/example-corp.pdf",
      "settlement_date": "2026-04-04",
      "ticker_symbol": "EXMP",
      "trade_date": "2026-04-02",
      "underwriters": [
        "Goldman Sachs",
        "Morgan Stanley"
      ],
      "unit_step_size": "1"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": null
}
```

<h3 id="list-ipo-offerings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A page of IPO offerings.|[IPOOfferingListResponse](#schemaipoofferinglistresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BasicAuth
</aside>

## Retrieve an IPO Offering

<a id="opIdgetIPOOffering"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/v1/ipos/FI111225 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/ipos/{offering_reference}`

Returns a single IPO offering by `offering_reference`.

The `offering_reference` value matches the one delivered on the [IPO Events Stream](#operation/subscribeToIPOEventsSSE).


<h3 id="retrieve-an-ipo-offering-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|offering_reference|path|string|true|The unique offering identifier (also referred to as `ipo_reference` in the response body).|

```json
{

    "availability": "available",
    "cusip_id": "123456789",
    "description": "Example Corp is a leading provider of example services.",
    "ipo_reference": "FI111225",
    "logo_small": "https://example.com/logos/exmp-small.png",
    "max_price": "44",
    "max_ticket_size": "100000",
    "min_price": "40",
    "min_ticket_size": "100",
    "name": "Example Corp",
    "no_new_orders": false,
    "offering_type": "IPO",
    "prospectus_url": "https://example.com/prospectus/example-corp.pdf",

    "trade_date": "2026-04-02",
    "underwriters": [
      "Goldman Sachs",
      "Morgan Stanley"
    ],
    "unit_step_size": "1"
  }
}
```

|200|OK|The requested IPO offering.|[IPOOfferingResponse](#schemaipoofferingresponse)|

|amount|string(decimal)|false|none|Amount of cash to be transferred. Can be positive or negative. Use `transfer_all` to transfer the entire balance instead of specifying an amount -- `amount` and `transfer_all: true` are mutually exclusive, and sending both is rejected with HTTP 400.|
|currency|string|true|none|Currency of the cash balance. Only `USD` is currently supported; any other value is rejected with HTTP 400. Each currency may appear at most once in the `cash` array.|
|transfer_all|boolean|false|none|Set to true to transfer the entire balance of this currency. Must not be combined with `amount`. Setting it to `false` without an `amount` is rejected with HTTP 400.|

|Property|Value|

<h2 id="tocS_AcatsEquity">AcatsEquity</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaacatsequity"></a>
<a id="schema_AcatsEquity"></a>
<a id="tocSacatsequity"></a>
<a id="tocsacatsequity"></a>

```json
{
  "position": "LONG",
  "qty": "2",
  "symbol": "AAPL"
}
```

Equity asset requested in a partial transfer. Identify the security with either `cusip` or `symbol` -- provide one, not both. Prefer `cusip` when you have it: it is a stable, unambiguous identifier. Use `symbol` only when a CUSIP is not available, as ticker symbols can change or be reused over time.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cusip|string|false|none|CUSIP security identifier for the asset -- 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters followed by a check character, which may be a digit or one of `*`, `@`, `#`. Recommended over `symbol` for unambiguous identification. Provide either `cusip` or `symbol`, not both.|
|position|string|false|none|Position type. Only `LONG` and `SHORT` are accepted for equities -- `CREDIT` and `DEBIT` apply to cash positions and are rejected with HTTP 400 here.|
|qty|string(decimal)|false|none|Quantity of assets to transfer. Use `transfer_all` to transfer the entire position instead of specifying a quantity -- `qty` and `transfer_all: true` are mutually exclusive, and sending both is rejected with HTTP 400. Note that the ACATS system will only transfer whole shares.|
|symbol|string|false|none|Stock ticker symbol (e.g. `AAPL`, `BRK.B`, `GOOGL`). Up to 6 alphanumeric characters, optionally followed by a single `.` or `-` separator and a 1-5 letter suffix. Values are trimmed and upper-cased before validation. Use only when a CUSIP is not available, since symbols can change or be reused over time. Provide either `cusip` or `symbol`, not both.|
|transfer_all|boolean|false|none|Set to true to transfer the entire balance of this asset. Must not be combined with `qty`. Setting it to `false` without a `qty` is rejected with HTTP 400.|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|position|LONG|
|position|SHORT|

<h2 id="tocS_AcatsInitiateTransferDetails">AcatsInitiateTransferDetails</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaacatsinitiatetransferdetails"></a>
<a id="schema_AcatsInitiateTransferDetails"></a>
<a id="tocSacatsinitiatetransferdetails"></a>
<a id="tocsacatsinitiatetransferdetails"></a>

```json
{
  "cash": [
    {
      "amount": "10000",
      "currency": "USD"
    }
  ],
  "securities": {
    "equities": [
      {
        "cusip": "037833100",
        "position": "LONG",
        "qty": "2"
      },
      {
        "cusip": "78462F103",
        "position": "SHORT"
      }
    ]
  },
  "type": "PARTIAL"
}
```

Transfer details. The two transfer types are mutually exclusive in what they accept:
- `FULL`: do not include a non-empty `cash` or `securities.equities` array (the entire account will be transferred). Including either non-empty is rejected with HTTP 400.
- `PARTIAL`: specify which assets to transfer using the `cash` and/or `securities` objects. At least one of the two must be present and non-empty, otherwise the request is rejected with HTTP 400.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cash|[[AcatsCashBalance](#schemaacatscashbalance)]|false|none|Cash amounts to transfer. Only used for PARTIAL transfers. Must be omitted or empty for FULL transfers.|
|securities|object|false|none|Securities to transfer. Only used for PARTIAL transfers. Must be omitted or empty for FULL transfers.|
|type|[AcatsInitiateTransferType](#schemaacatsinitiatetransfertype)|true|none|Transfer type|
|*oneOf*|[FullTransfer](#schemafulltransfer)|false|none|Transfers the entire account. `cash` and `securities.equities`, if sent, must be empty.|
|*oneOf*|[PartialTransfer](#schemapartialtransfer)|false|none|Transfers selected assets. Must carry a non-empty `cash` array, a non-empty `securities.equities` array, or both.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|FULL|
|type|PARTIAL|

```json
{
  "contra_account_details": {
    "account_number": "A00000123",
    "broker_number": "0158",
    "customer_name": "Jane Doe",
    "customer_tax_id": "123456789"
  },
  "ip_address": "203.0.113.42",
  "signed_at": "2026-04-29T13:00:00Z",
  "transfer_details": {
    "cash": [
      {
        "amount": "10000",
        "currency": "USD"
      }
    ],
    "securities": {
      "equities": [
        {
          "position": "LONG",
          "qty": "2",
          "symbol": "AAPL"
        },
        {
          "cusip": "123456789",
          "position": "LONG",
          "qty": "5"
        },
        {
          "position": "SHORT",
          "symbol": "TSLA"
        }
      ]
    },
    "type": "PARTIAL"
  }
}
```

Request body for initiating an incoming ACATS transfer.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contra_account_details|[AcatsContraAccountDetails](#schemaacatscontraaccountdetails)|true|none|Contra account details|
|ip_address|string|true|none|IP address from which the account holder initiated the transfer (IPv4 or IPv6)|
|signed_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp at which the account holder signed/authorized the transfer. Must be within the last week and must not be in the future (a 5 minute grace period absorbs clock skew); values outside that window are rejected with HTTP 400.|
|transfer_details|[AcatsInitiateTransferDetails](#schemaacatsinitiatetransferdetails)|true|none|Transfer details. The two transfer types are mutually exclusive in what they accept:<br>- `FULL`: do not include a non-empty `cash` or `securities.equities` array (the entire account will be transferred). Including either non-empty is rejected with HTTP 400.<br>- `PARTIAL`: specify which assets to transfer using the `cash` and/or `securities` objects. At least one of the two must be present and non-empty, otherwise the request is rejected with HTTP 400.<br>|
|validate_account_number|boolean|false|none|Whether to validate the contra account number against the contra broker's configured format rules. Defaults to false (no per-broker format check). Set to true to opt in, in which case a number that matches none of the broker's enabled rules is rejected with HTTP 422.|

Represents high level account info. Used when returning entire account information would not be useful like the getAllAccounts operation

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_number|string \| null|true|none|A human-readable account number that can be shown to the end user|
|account_type|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|false|none|The account type returned for the account.|
|agreements|[[Agreement](#schemaagreement)]|false|none|none|
|allow_instant_ach|boolean|false|none|Determines whether the account is enabled for Instant ACH by the partner.|
|cash_interest|[AccountCashInterestResponse](#schemaaccountcashinterestresponse)|false|none|The configuration and status of the account's USD cash interest program<br>|
|contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|Contact is the model for the account owner contact information.<br>|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp (RFC3339) of account creation.|
|crypto_status|[AccountStatus](#schemaaccountstatus)|false|none|Designates the current status of this account<br><br>Possible Values:<br>- **INACTIVE**<br>Account not set to trade given asset.<br>- **PAPER_ONLY**<br>The account is limited to paper trading.<br>- **ONBOARDING**<br>An application is expected for this user, but has not been submitted yet.<br>- **SUBMITTED**<br>The application has been submitted and is being processed.<br>- **SUBMISSION_FAILED**<br>Used to display if failure on submission<br>- **ACTION_REQUIRED**<br>The application requires manual action.<br>- **ACCOUNT_UPDATED**<br>Used to display when Account has been modified by user<br>- **APPROVAL_PENDING**<br>Initial value. The application approval process is in progress.<br>- **APPROVED**<br>The account application has been approved, and waiting to be ACTIVE<br>- **REJECTED**<br>The account application is rejected for some reason<br>- **ACTIVE**<br>The account is fully active. Trading and funding are processed under this status.<br>- **ACCOUNT_CLOSED**<br>The account is closed.<br>|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|"USD" // US Dollar<br>"JPY" // Japanese Yen<br>"EUR" // Euro<br>"CAD" // Canadian Dollar<br>"GBP" // British Pound Sterling<br>"CHF" // Swiss Franc<br>"TRY" // Turkish Lira<br>"AUD" // Australian Dollar<br>"CZK" // Czech Koruna<br>"SEK" // Swedish Krona<br>"DKK" // Danish Krone<br>"SGD" // Singapore Dollar<br>"HKD" // Hong Kong Dollar<br>"HUF" // Hungarian Forint<br>"NZD" // New Zealand Dollar<br>"NOK" // Norwegian Krone<br>"PLN" // Poland Złoty|
|disclosures|[Disclosures](#schemadisclosures)|false|none|Disclosures fields denote if the account owner falls under<br>each category defined by FINRA rule. The client has to ask<br>questions for the end user and the values should reflect<br>their answers.<br>If one of the answers is true (yes), the account goes into<br>ACTION_REQUIRED status.<br>|
|documents|[[OwnerDocument](#schemaownerdocument)]|false|none|The documents associated with the primary owner of the account|
|enabled_assets|[[EnabledAssetClass](#schemaenabledassetclass)]|false|none|Assets the user has enabled and is able to trade once status and/or crypto_status are ACTIVE|
|fpsl|[AccountFPSLResponse](#schemaaccountfpslresponse)|false|none|The account's Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) configuration.<br>This is only returned for accounts that have FPSL enabled.<br>|
|id|string(uuid)|true|none|UUID that identifies the account for later reference|
|identity|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity is the model to provide account owner's identity information.<br>|
|instant_ach_blocked|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the account is blocked for Instant ACH by Alpaca. Defaults to false when the partner creates the account. If the partner has set allow_instant_ach to true but instant_ach_blocked is true, then the account is blocked for Instant ACH irrespective of the fact that the partner has it enabled.|
|last_equity|string(decimal)|true|none|EOD equity calculation (cash + long market value + short market value)|
|primary_account_holder_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|UUID of the account's primary holder when available; otherwise `null`.|
|status|[AccountStatus](#schemaaccountstatus)|true|none|Designates the current status of this account<br><br>Possible Values:<br>- **INACTIVE**<br>Account not set to trade given asset.<br>- **PAPER_ONLY**<br>The account is limited to paper trading.<br>- **ONBOARDING**<br>An application is expected for this user, but has not been submitted yet.<br>- **SUBMITTED**<br>The application has been submitted and is being processed.<br>- **SUBMISSION_FAILED**<br>Used to display if failure on submission<br>- **ACTION_REQUIRED**<br>The application requires manual action.<br>- **ACCOUNT_UPDATED**<br>Used to display when Account has been modified by user<br>- **APPROVAL_PENDING**<br>Initial value. The application approval process is in progress.<br>- **APPROVED**<br>The account application has been approved, and waiting to be ACTIVE<br>- **REJECTED**<br>The account application is rejected for some reason<br>- **ACTIVE**<br>The account is fully active. Trading and funding are processed under this status.<br>- **ACCOUNT_CLOSED**<br>The account is closed.<br>|
|trusted_contact|[TrustedContact](#schematrustedcontact)|false|none|This model input is optional. However, the client should make a reasonable effort to obtain the trusted contact information. See [FINRA Notice 17-11](https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/Regulatory-Notice-17-11.pdf) for more details.<br><br>At least one of the following is required:<br>- `email_address`<br>- `phone_number`<br>- `street_address`<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_AccountCashInterestEvent">AccountCashInterestEvent</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccountcashinterestevent"></a>
<a id="schema_AccountCashInterestEvent"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountcashinterestevent"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountcashinterestevent"></a>

```json
{
  "apr_tier_name_from": "string",
  "apr_tier_name_to": "string",
  "currency": "USD",
  "status_from": "string",
  "status_to": "string"
}
```

This property is included when the account's cash interest program had changed due to an enrollment, APR tier change, or unenrollment.
The from and to status or APR tier name will be included in the event, depending on the change.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apr_tier_name_from|string|false|none|The APR tier name before the change|
|apr_tier_name_to|string|false|none|The APR tier name after the change|
|currency|string|false|none|The currency of the cash interest program that changed.|
|status_from|string|false|none|The cash_interest program status of the account before the change|
|status_to|string|false|none|The cash_interest program status of the account after the change|

<h2 id="tocS_AccountCashInterestPatch">AccountCashInterestPatch</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccountcashinterestpatch"></a>
<a id="schema_AccountCashInterestPatch"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountcashinterestpatch"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountcashinterestpatch"></a>

```json
{
  "USD": {
    "apr_tier_name": "gold",
    "status": "ACTIVE"
  }
}
```

Use this property to change the account's configuration for the USD cash interest program.
To enroll the account, specify the apr_tier_name. The status should not be specified on enrollment.
To change the APR tier, specify the new apr_tier_name. The status should not be specified on tier changes.
The unenroll, set the status to INACTIVE.
After any change, the response will contain a status of PENDING_CHANGE.
An event showing the status change to ACTIVE (for enrollment or tier changes) or INACTIVE (for unenrollment) will be generated when the change is complete.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|USD|[AccountCashInterestProgram](#schemaaccountcashinterestprogram)|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_AccountCashInterestPost">AccountCashInterestPost</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccountcashinterestpost"></a>
<a id="schema_AccountCashInterestPost"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountcashinterestpost"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountcashinterestpost"></a>

```json
{
  "USD": {
    "apr_tier_name": "gold",
    "status": "ACTIVE"
  }
}
```

The configuration of the account's USD cash interest program when creating an account.
If cash_interest is not provided and the request signs the required Alpaca Customer Agreement revision, the account may be enrolled in a default APR tier automatically. Do not rely on this; provide the cash_interest object with the desired apr_tier_name. The status should not be specified on enrollment.
The response will contain a status of PENDING_CHANGE. An event showing the status change to ACTIVE will be generated when the enrollment is complete.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|USD|[AccountCashInterestProgram](#schemaaccountcashinterestprogram)|false|none|none|

<a id="tocSaccountcashinterestprogram"></a>

```json
{
  "apr_tier_name": "gold",
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apr_tier_name|string|false|none|The unique name of the APR tier for a specific program|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the account within a cash interest program. One of:<br>- **ACTIVE**<br>The account is enrolled and eligible for idle cash to be swept at the end of day (EOD).<br>- **INACTIVE**<br>The account is not enrolled due to it either not being eligible (e.g. the updated Alpaca Customer Agreement has not been signed), an APR tier needs to be assigned, or they have been unenrolled.<br>- **PENDING_CHANGE**<br>An enrollment, APR Tier change, or unenrollment is in progress<br>|

Fields accepted when creating an account. Requirements vary by account type, enabled assets, existing holder agreements, and correspondent configuration. The server enforces conditional requirements that are not represented statically in this schema.

Account-specific requirements:
- Trading accounts require inline `identity` plus `contact`, or an existing holder through `primary_account_holder_id`. Individual US equity accounts created with inline identity also require `disclosures`.
- Custodial accounts require `identity` and `minor_identity`. US equity accounts also require `disclosures`.
- IRA accounts require `account_sub_type`, US equity, and either inline `identity` or an existing holder through `primary_account_holder_id`; they do not support crypto. IRA accounts created with inline identity also require `disclosures`.
- Donor-advised accounts require `entity_id`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_sub_type|object|false|none|The account subtype. Required for IRA accounts.|
|account_type|object|false|none|The account type. Defaults to `trading` when omitted.|
|agreements|[[Agreement](#schemaagreement)]|false|none|Agreements submitted for the account or holder. Required agreement types depend on account type, enabled assets, existing holder agreements, and correspondent configuration. The server validates required coverage.|
|allow_instant_ach|boolean|false|none|Determines whether the account will be enabled for Instant ACH by the partner. Defaults to false if not provided.|
|beneficiaries|[[Beneficiary](#schemabeneficiary)]|false|none|IRA Account only. A user can submit max 6 beneficiaries.|
|cash_interest|[AccountCashInterestPost](#schemaaccountcashinterestpost)|false|none|The configuration of the account's USD cash interest program when creating an account.<br>If cash_interest is not provided and the request signs the required Alpaca Customer Agreement revision, the account may be enrolled in a default APR tier automatically. Do not rely on this; provide the cash_interest object with the desired apr_tier_name. The status should not be specified on enrollment.<br>The response will contain a status of PENDING_CHANGE. An event showing the status change to ACTIVE will be generated when the enrollment is complete.<br>|
|contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|Contact is the model for the account owner contact information.<br>|
|disclosures|[Disclosures](#schemadisclosures)|false|none|Disclosures fields denote if the account owner falls under<br>each category defined by FINRA rule. The client has to ask<br>questions for the end user and the values should reflect<br>their answers.<br>If one of the answers is true (yes), the account goes into<br>ACTION_REQUIRED status.<br>|
|documents|[[OwnerDocumentUploadRequest](#schemaownerdocumentuploadrequest)]|false|none|none|
|enabled_assets|[[EnabledAssetClass](#schemaenabledassetclass)]|false|none|Will default to `us_equity`. Alpaca has the ability to update the default value upon request.|
|entity_id|string(uuid)|false|none|UUID of an existing legal entity used as the holder of a donor-advised account. Required for donor-advised accounts.|
|fpsl|[AccountFPSLPost](#schemaaccountfpslpost)|false|none|The account's Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) configuration.<br>To enroll the account for a market, specify the tier_id. The status should not be specified on enrollment.<br>Currently only the US market is supported.<br>|
|identity|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity is the model to provide account owner's identity information.<br>|
|investment_objective|string|false|none|The user's investment objective. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `investment_objective` under identity.<br>|
|investment_time_horizon|string|false|none|The expected period of time the user plan to invest to achieve his/her financial goal(s). This field should be used instead of the deprecated `investment_time_horizon` under identity.<br>|
|liquidity_needs|string|false|none|The user's ability to quickly and easily convert to cash all or a portion of the investments in this account without experiencing significant loss in value. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `liquidity_needs` under identity.<br>|
|minor_identity|object|false|none|Identity information for the minor. Required for custodial accounts.|
|primary_account_holder_id|string(uuid)|false|none|UUID of an existing party to use as the primary account holder. Among the documented account types, existing holders are supported for trading and IRA accounts.<br><br>When provided, omit inline holder fields such as `contact`, `identity`, `disclosures`, and `minor_identity`. The server validates the referenced party, account-type compatibility, eligibility, and required agreements.<br>|
|risk_tolerance|string|false|none|The user's investment risk tolerance. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `risk_tolerance` under identity.<br>|
|trading_configurations|[AccountConfigurations](#schemaaccountconfigurations)|false|none|Represents additional configuration settings for an account|
|trusted_contact|[TrustedContact](#schematrustedcontact)|false|none|This model input is optional. However, the client should make a reasonable effort to obtain the trusted contact information. See [FINRA Notice 17-11](https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/Regulatory-Notice-17-11.pdf) for more details.<br><br>At least one of the following is required:<br>- `email_address`<br>- `phone_number`<br>- `street_address`<br>|

Represents an account with all data available. If your api response is missing some of these fields, there is a good chance you are using a route that returns `Account` instances instead of these.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_name|string|false|none|none|
|account_number|string \| null|true|none|none|
|account_sub_type|[AccountSubType](#schemaaccountsubtype)|false|none|IRA Account only<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br>- traditional<br>- roth|
|account_type|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|true|none|The account type returned for the account.|
|agreements|[[Agreement](#schemaagreement)]|false|none|none|
|allow_instant_ach|boolean|false|none|Determines whether the account is enabled for Instant ACH by the partner.|
|beneficiaries|[[Beneficiary](#schemabeneficiary)]|false|none|none|
|cash_interest|[AccountCashInterestResponse](#schemaaccountcashinterestresponse)|false|none|The configuration and status of the account's USD cash interest program<br>|
|contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|Contact is the model for the account owner contact information.<br>|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|crypto_status|[AccountStatus](#schemaaccountstatus)|false|none|Designates the current status of this account<br><br>Possible Values:<br>- **INACTIVE**<br>Account not set to trade given asset.<br>- **PAPER_ONLY**<br>The account is limited to paper trading.<br>- **ONBOARDING**<br>An application is expected for this user, but has not been submitted yet.<br>- **SUBMITTED**<br>The application has been submitted and is being processed.<br>- **SUBMISSION_FAILED**<br>Used to display if failure on submission<br>- **ACTION_REQUIRED**<br>The application requires manual action.<br>- **ACCOUNT_UPDATED**<br>Used to display when Account has been modified by user<br>- **APPROVAL_PENDING**<br>Initial value. The application approval process is in progress.<br>- **APPROVED**<br>The account application has been approved, and waiting to be ACTIVE<br>- **REJECTED**<br>The account application is rejected for some reason<br>- **ACTIVE**<br>The account is fully active. Trading and funding are processed under this status.<br>- **ACCOUNT_CLOSED**<br>The account is closed.<br>|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|"USD" // US Dollar<br>"JPY" // Japanese Yen<br>"EUR" // Euro<br>"CAD" // Canadian Dollar<br>"GBP" // British Pound Sterling<br>"CHF" // Swiss Franc<br>"TRY" // Turkish Lira<br>"AUD" // Australian Dollar<br>"CZK" // Czech Koruna<br>"SEK" // Swedish Krona<br>"DKK" // Danish Krone<br>"SGD" // Singapore Dollar<br>"HKD" // Hong Kong Dollar<br>"HUF" // Hungarian Forint<br>"NZD" // New Zealand Dollar<br>"NOK" // Norwegian Krone<br>"PLN" // Poland Złoty|
|custodial_account_type|[CustodialAccountType](#schemacustodialaccounttype)|false|none|Represents the type of custodial account based on the state where the beneficiary resides.<br>This value is returned only when the `country_of_tax_residence` is `USA`. For other countries, this property is not included in the response.<br><br>**Possible Return Values**<br><br>`CustodianTypeUTMA` - Indicates that the custodial account is governed by the Uniform Transfers to Minors Act.<br>`CustodianTypeUGMA` - Indicates that the custodial account is governed by the Uniform Gifts to Minors Act.|
|disclosures|[Disclosures](#schemadisclosures)|false|none|Disclosures fields denote if the account owner falls under<br>each category defined by FINRA rule. The client has to ask<br>questions for the end user and the values should reflect<br>their answers.<br>If one of the answers is true (yes), the account goes into<br>ACTION_REQUIRED status.<br>|
|documents|[[OwnerDocument](#schemaownerdocument)]|false|none|The documents associated with the primary owner of the account|
|enabled_assets|[[EnabledAssetClass](#schemaenabledassetclass)]|false|none|none|
|fpsl|[AccountFPSLResponse](#schemaaccountfpslresponse)|false|none|The account's Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) configuration.<br>This is only returned for accounts that have FPSL enabled.<br>|
|id|string(uuid)|true|none|none|
|identity|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity is the model to provide account owner's identity information.<br>|
|instant_ach_blocked|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the account is blocked for Instant ACH by Alpaca. Defaults to false when the partner creates the account. If the partner has set allow_instant_ach to true but instant_ach_blocked is true, then the account is blocked for Instant ACH irrespective of the fact that the partner has it enabled.|
|investment_objective|string|false|none|The user's investment objective. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `investment_objective` under identity.<br>|
|investment_time_horizon|string|false|none|The expected period of time the user plan to invest to achieve his/her financial goal(s). This field should be used instead of the deprecated `investment_time_horizon` under identity.<br>|
|kyc_results|[KYCResults](#schemakycresults)|false|none|Holds information about the result of KYC.<br><br>`accept`, `indeterminate`, and `reject` are nullable sets represented as objects. Each property name is a KYC reason identifier, and every property value is always an empty object (`{}`) carrying no nested data. For example:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>  "IDENTITY_VERIFICATION": {},<br>  "WATCHLIST_HIT": {}<br>}<br>```<br><br>Interpret each reason together with its enclosing result category and `additional_information`.<br><br>Documented reason identifiers:<br>- `IDENTITY_VERIFICATION`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's identity.<br>- `TAX_IDENTIFICATION`: A tax identification document is required to verify the account owner's tax identification number.<br>- `ADDRESS_VERIFICATION`: Additional documentation, such as a government-issued ID or statement, may be required to verify the account owner's residential address.<br>- `DATE_OF_BIRTH`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's date of birth.<br>- `SELFIE_VERIFICATION`: A live selfie of the account owner is required to verify identity.<br>- `PEP`: The account owner disclosed politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member is politically exposed, and additional information may be required.<br>- `CONTROL_PERSON`: Additional company information may be required because the account owner disclosed a control position.<br>- `AFFILIATED`: Additional firm information may be required because the account owner disclosed an affiliation with FINRA or an exchange.<br>- `VISA_TYPE_OTHER`: The account owner's visa type and expiration date may be required because the submitted visa type was "other."<br>- `W8BEN_CORRECTION`: A new W-8BEN with corrected identifying information is required.<br>- `COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of tax residence or legal residence is not supported for this account.<br>- `WATCHLIST_HIT`: Watchlist screening returned a result that requires further review; no action is needed from the account owner unless separately requested.<br>- `OTHER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message describing what is required from the account owner.<br>- `OTHER_PARTNER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message intended for the Broker API partner.<br>- `CITIZENSHIP_COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of citizenship is not supported for this account.<br>- `DIFFERING_COUNTRY`: A submitted identity document was issued by a country different from the account owner's country of tax residence.<br>- `WL_PEP_SCREENING`: Watchlist screening returned a result related to possible political exposure.<br>- `WL_LEGAL_REGULATORY_WARNING`: Watchlist screening returned a legal or regulatory warning result.<br>- `UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE`: The account owner does not meet the minimum age requirement for this account.<br>- `PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member has foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `DISCRETIONARY`: The account is designated for discretionary trading by a registered investment adviser and requires review.<br>- `HIO`: Additional information and a declaration form may be required because the account owner disclosed being the head of an international organization.<br>- `INTERNAL_CHECK`: A non-specific account-opening check contributed to the KYC outcome; no more specific reason is available.<br>- `compromised_document`: The identity document check indicated that the document may be compromised.<br>- `data_comparison`: Data extracted from the identity document did not pass comparison checks and requires review.<br>- `image_integrity`: A document or selfie image did not pass image-integrity checks and requires review.<br><br>The set of reason identifiers is extensible, so integrations must tolerate and preserve unrecognized values.<br>|
|last_equity|string(decimal)|true|none|none|
|liquidity_needs|string|false|none|The user's ability to quickly and easily convert to cash all or a portion of the investments in this account without experiencing significant loss in value. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `liquidity_needs` under identity.<br>|
|minor_identity|[CustodialAccountMinorIdentity](#schemacustodialaccountminoridentity)|false|none|Represents Identity information for a minor that an account of type "custodial" is for|
|primary_account_holder_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|UUID of the account's primary holder when available; otherwise `null`.|
|risk_tolerance|string|false|none|The user's investment risk tolerance. This field should be used instead of the deprecated `risk_tolerance` under identity.<br>|
|status|[AccountStatus](#schemaaccountstatus)|true|none|Designates the current status of this account<br><br>Possible Values:<br>- **INACTIVE**<br>Account not set to trade given asset.<br>- **PAPER_ONLY**<br>The account is limited to paper trading.<br>- **ONBOARDING**<br>An application is expected for this user, but has not been submitted yet.<br>- **SUBMITTED**<br>The application has been submitted and is being processed.<br>- **SUBMISSION_FAILED**<br>Used to display if failure on submission<br>- **ACTION_REQUIRED**<br>The application requires manual action.<br>- **ACCOUNT_UPDATED**<br>Used to display when Account has been modified by user<br>- **APPROVAL_PENDING**<br>Initial value. The application approval process is in progress.<br>- **APPROVED**<br>The account application has been approved, and waiting to be ACTIVE<br>- **REJECTED**<br>The account application is rejected for some reason<br>- **ACTIVE**<br>The account is fully active. Trading and funding are processed under this status.<br>- **ACCOUNT_CLOSED**<br>The account is closed.<br>|
|trading_configurations|[AccountConfigurations](#schemaaccountconfigurations)|false|none|Represents additional configuration settings for an account|
|trusted_contact|[TrustedContact](#schematrustedcontact)|false|none|This model input is optional. However, the client should make a reasonable effort to obtain the trusted contact information. See [FINRA Notice 17-11](https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/Regulatory-Notice-17-11.pdf) for more details.<br><br>At least one of the following is required:<br>- `email_address`<br>- `phone_number`<br>- `street_address`<br>|
|usd|object|false|none|values in USD. This is returned for LCT (non-USD) accounts only.|

<h2 id="tocS_AccountFPSLPatch">AccountFPSLPatch</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccountfpslpatch"></a>
<a id="schema_AccountFPSLPatch"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountfpslpatch"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountfpslpatch"></a>

```json
{
  "US": {
    "status": "ACTIVE",
    "tier_id": "61e69015-8549-4bfd-b9c3-01e75843f47d"
  }
}
```

The account's Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) configuration.
Use this property to change the account's configuration for the FPSL program.
To enroll the account for a market, specify the tier_id. The status should not be specified on enrollment.
To change the tier, specify the new tier_id. The status should not be specified on tier changes.
To unenroll, set the status to INACTIVE.
To re-enroll the account, set the status to ACTIVE. You can also specify the tier_id in case you want to change it.
Currently only US market is supported.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|US|[AccountFPSLItem](#schemaaccountfpslitem)|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_AccountStatus">AccountStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccountstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_AccountStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountstatus"></a>

```json
"ACTIVE"
```

Designates the current status of this account

Possible Values:
- **INACTIVE**
Account not set to trade given asset.
- **PAPER_ONLY**
The account is limited to paper trading.
- **ONBOARDING**
An application is expected for this user, but has not been submitted yet.
- **SUBMITTED**
The application has been submitted and is being processed.
- **SUBMISSION_FAILED**
Used to display if failure on submission
- **ACTION_REQUIRED**
The application requires manual action.
- **ACCOUNT_UPDATED**
Used to display when Account has been modified by user
- **APPROVAL_PENDING**
Initial value. The application approval process is in progress.
- **APPROVED**
The account application has been approved, and waiting to be ACTIVE
- **REJECTED**
The account application is rejected for some reason
- **ACTIVE**
The account is fully active. Trading and funding are processed under this status.
- **ACCOUNT_CLOSED**
The account is closed.

```json
  "at": "2021-06-14T09:59:15.232782Z",
  "event_id": 122039,
  "event_ulid": "01F84ZC0H0Q1QN7XPNWX44HF5J",
  "status_from": "",
  "status_to": "APPROVED"
}
```

Represents a change to certain account properties, sent over the events streaming API.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true the account was blocked, if false, the account got unblocked|
|account_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the account that was changed|
|account_number|string|false|none|The account number of the account that was changed|
|admin_configurations|[AdminConfigurationsEvent](#schemaadminconfigurationsevent)|false|none|Represents a change to admin configurations, as broadcast over the **events** streaming API. Only fields whose value changed are included; unrelated update events will not include a flag that did not change.<br><br>Depending on the type of the Admin Configuration, the sent event will behave differently. For bool flags we are only sending the new value.<br><br>For example, the following payload means that the disable_shorting flag was set to true:<br><br>```<br>{<br>  "disable_shorting": true<br>}<br>```<br><br>For other data types, we are embedding the old and new values into the payload. For example changing the max_margin_multiplier from 4 to 1 will yield this payload:<br><br>```<br>{<br>  "max_margin_multiplier": {<br>    "from": 4,<br>    "to": 1<br>  }<br>}<br>```<br><br>Introducing an override value from the default will yield a null value as `from`. For example restricting the max_margin_multiplier to 1 from default will yield the following payload:<br><br>```<br>{<br>  "max_margin_multiplier": {<br>    "from": null,<br>    "to": 1<br>  }<br>}<br>```|
|at|string|true|none|timestamp of event|
|cash_interest|[AccountCashInterestEvent](#schemaaccountcashinterestevent)|false|none|This property is included when the account's cash interest program had changed due to an enrollment, APR tier change, or unenrollment.<br>The from and to status or APR tier name will be included in the event, depending on the change.<br>|
|crypto_status_from|string|false|none|account crypto_status changed from|
|crypto_status_to|string|false|none|account crypto_status changed to|
|event_id|integer|false|none|Monotonically increasing 64-bit integer not available to new partners, and for backward compatibility purposes only; use `event_ulid` as the stable identifier where possible<br>|
|event_ulid|string(ulid)|true|none|lexically sortable, monotonically increasing character array|
|fpsl|[AccountFPSLEvent](#schemaaccountfpslevent)|false|none|This property is included when the account's FPSL information had changed due to an enrollment, tier change, or unenrollment.<br>The from and to status or tier id will be included in the event, depending on the change.<br>|
|kyc_results|[KYCResults](#schemakycresults)|false|none|Holds information about the result of KYC.<br><br>`accept`, `indeterminate`, and `reject` are nullable sets represented as objects. Each property name is a KYC reason identifier, and every property value is always an empty object (`{}`) carrying no nested data. For example:<br><br>```json<br>{<br>  "IDENTITY_VERIFICATION": {},<br>  "WATCHLIST_HIT": {}<br>}<br>```<br><br>Interpret each reason together with its enclosing result category and `additional_information`.<br><br>Documented reason identifiers:<br>- `IDENTITY_VERIFICATION`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's identity.<br>- `TAX_IDENTIFICATION`: A tax identification document is required to verify the account owner's tax identification number.<br>- `ADDRESS_VERIFICATION`: Additional documentation, such as a government-issued ID or statement, may be required to verify the account owner's residential address.<br>- `DATE_OF_BIRTH`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's date of birth.<br>- `SELFIE_VERIFICATION`: A live selfie of the account owner is required to verify identity.<br>- `PEP`: The account owner disclosed politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member is politically exposed, and additional information may be required.<br>- `CONTROL_PERSON`: Additional company information may be required because the account owner disclosed a control position.<br>- `AFFILIATED`: Additional firm information may be required because the account owner disclosed an affiliation with FINRA or an exchange.<br>- `VISA_TYPE_OTHER`: The account owner's visa type and expiration date may be required because the submitted visa type was "other."<br>- `W8BEN_CORRECTION`: A new W-8BEN with corrected identifying information is required.<br>- `COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of tax residence or legal residence is not supported for this account.<br>- `WATCHLIST_HIT`: Watchlist screening returned a result that requires further review; no action is needed from the account owner unless separately requested.<br>- `OTHER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message describing what is required from the account owner.<br>- `OTHER_PARTNER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message intended for the Broker API partner.<br>- `CITIZENSHIP_COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of citizenship is not supported for this account.<br>- `DIFFERING_COUNTRY`: A submitted identity document was issued by a country different from the account owner's country of tax residence.<br>- `WL_PEP_SCREENING`: Watchlist screening returned a result related to possible political exposure.<br>- `WL_LEGAL_REGULATORY_WARNING`: Watchlist screening returned a legal or regulatory warning result.<br>- `UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE`: The account owner does not meet the minimum age requirement for this account.<br>- `PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member has foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.<br>- `DISCRETIONARY`: The account is designated for discretionary trading by a registered investment adviser and requires review.<br>- `HIO`: Additional information and a declaration form may be required because the account owner disclosed being the head of an international organization.<br>- `INTERNAL_CHECK`: A non-specific account-opening check contributed to the KYC outcome; no more specific reason is available.<br>- `compromised_document`: The identity document check indicated that the document may be compromised.<br>- `data_comparison`: Data extracted from the identity document did not pass comparison checks and requires review.<br>- `image_integrity`: A document or selfie image did not pass image-integrity checks and requires review.<br><br>The set of reason identifiers is extensible, so integrations must tolerate and preserve unrecognized values.<br>|
|options|[OptionsApprovalEvent](#schemaoptionsapprovalevent)|false|none|This property is included when the account's approved options level changes.<br>|
|reason|string|false|none|**Deprecated.**|
|status_from|string|false|none|The account status before the change|
|status_to|string|false|none|The account status after the change|
|trading_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true the account cannot trade going forward, if false, the ban has been lifted|

The status should not be specified on enrollment.<br>To change the tier, specify the new tier_id. The status should not be specified on tier changes.<br>To unenroll, set the status to INACTIVE.<br>To re-enroll the account, set the status to ACTIVE. You can also specify the tier_id in case you want to change it.<br>Currently only US market is supported.<br>|
|identity|[Identity](#schemaidentity)|false|none|Identity is the model to provide account owner's identity information.<br>|
|primary_account_holder_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The UUID of the primary account holder. This field is immutable after the account is created.<br><br>- Omitting the field, or supplying the value already associated with the account, is a no-op.<br>- Supplying a value different from the current primary account holder returns HTTP 403.<br>|

Represents a more specific classification to the `activity_type`.
This field is optional and may not always be populated, depending on the activity type and the available data.
Each `activity_type` has a set of valid `activity_sub_type` values.

Full mapping of `activity_type` to `activity_sub_type`:

- **CGD**: Capital Gains Distribution activity sub-types:
  - **LTCG**: Long-Term Capital Gain
  - **STCG**: Short-Term Capital Gain

- **DIV**: Dividend activity sub-types:
  - **CDIV**: Cash Dividend
  - **ROC**: Return of Capital
  - **SDIV**: Stock Dividend
  - **SPD**: Substitute Payment In Lieu Of Dividend

- **FEE**: Fee-related activity sub-types:
  - **REG**: Regulatory Fee
  - **TAF**: Trading Activity Fee
  - **LCT**: Local Currency Trading Fee
  - **ORF**: Options Regulatory Fee
  - **OCC**: Options Clearing Corporation Fee
  - **NRC**: Non-Retail Commission Fee
  - **NRV**: Non-Retail Venue Fee
  - **COM**: Commission
  - **CAT**: Consolidated Audit Trail Fee

- **INT**: Interest-related activity sub-types:
  - **MGN**: Margin Interest
  - **CDT**: Credit Interest
  - **SWP**: Sweep Interest
  - **QII**: Qualified Interest
  - **FI**: Fixed Income Interest (coupon or accrued)

- **MA**: Merger and Acquisition activity sub-types:
  - **CMA**: Cash Merger
  - **SMA**: Stock Merger
  - **SCMA**: Stock & Cash Merger

- **NC**: Name Change activity sub types
  - **SNC**: Symbol Name Change
  - **CNC**: CUSIP Name Change
  - **SCNC**: Symbol & CUSIP Name Change

- **OPCA**: Option Corporate Action activity sub-types:
  - **DIV.CDIV**: Cash Dividend
  - **DIV.ROC**: Return of Capital
  - **DIV.SDIV**: Stock Dividend
  - **MA.CMA**: Cash Merger
  - **MA.SMA**: Stock Merger
  - **MA.SCMA**: Stock & Cash Merger
  - **NC.CNC**: CUSIP Name Change
  - **NC.SNC**: Symbol Name Change
  - **NC.SCNC**: Symbol & CUSIP Name Change
  - **SPIN**: Spin-off
  - **SPLIT.FSPLIT**: Forward Stock Split
  - **SPLIT.RSPLIT**: Reverse Stock Split
  - **SPLIT.USPLIT**: Unit Split

- **REO**: Reorganization activity sub-types:
  - **REOS**: Stock only (1 or more stock legs)
  - **REOC**: Cash only (one cash leg)
  - **REOSC**: Stock and cash

- **REORG**: Activity sub-types:
  - **WRM**: Worthless Removal

- **SPLIT**: Stock Split activity sub-types:
  - **FSPLIT**: Forward Stock Split
  - **RSPLIT**: Reverse Stock Split
  - **USPLIT**: Unit Split

- **VOF**: Voluntary Offering activity sub-types:
  - **VTND**: Tender Offer
  - **VWRT**: Warrant Exercise
  - **VRGT**: Rights Offer
  - **VEXH**: Exchange Offer

- **WH**: Withholding activity sub-types:
  - **SWH**: State Withholding
  - **FWH**: Federal Withholding
  - **SLWH**: Sales Withholding

```json
{
  "at": "2026-09-29T14:03:12.123456Z",
  "belongs_to_id_reference": "dfb80abb-7f52-35bd-b820-cad7e3edafec",
  "belongs_to_kind": "account",
  "category": "acats",
  "context": {
    "acats_id": "635e4b4a-baea-4b4d-a47e-406f3a9c6667",
    "status_details": {
      "broker_name": "Example Brokerage Inc.",
      "broker_number": "0001",
      "dtcc_reject_reason": "ACCOUNT_TITLE_MISMATCH",
      "dtcc_status": "REJECT",
      "rejection_message": "The account title does not match the account at the contra broker.",
      "transfer_direction": "INCOMING",

      "transfer_type": "FULL"
    },

  },

  "note": "",
  "type": "acats_status_admin_event",
  "visibility": "external"
}
```

Represents structure of an AcatsStatus type AdminAction.

Sent for ACATS transfers on accounts of correspondents with ACATS API access, whenever the transfer changes state: when the transfer is created (`PENDING`), when it is approved and submitted to DTCC (`IN_PROGRESS`), on each subsequent DTCC status change, and when it is `REJECTED` or `SETTLED`. Sent for both incoming and outgoing transfers, including transfers not initiated through the ACATS API.

The same status may be delivered more than once for a transfer. Use `context.acats_id` to correlate events with the transfer returned by the ACATS endpoints.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of event|
|belongs_to|object|false|none|none|
|belongs_to_id_reference|string|true|none|The ID of the entity that this event belongs to|
|belongs_to_kind|[AdminActionBelongsToKind](#schemaadminactionbelongstokind)|true|none|none|
|category|[AdminActionCategory](#schemaadminactioncategory)|true|none|Category of the Admin Action|
|correspondent|string|true|none|Related correspondent|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|created_by_id_reference|string|true|none|The ID of the entity that created this event|
|created_by_kind|[AdminActionCreatedByKind](#schemaadminactioncreatedbykind)|true|none|none|
|event_id|string(ulid)|true|none|Lexically sortable, monotonically increasing character array|
|note|string|true|none|Free text form description of the admin action|
|replaces_event_id|string(ulid)|false|none|Id of the replaced event (optional)|
|type|[AdminActionType](#schemaadminactiontype)|true|none|Type of the Admin Action|
|visibility|[AdminActionVisibility](#schemaadminactionvisibility)|true|none|Visibility of the Admin Action|
|context|object|true|none|Variable schema type which depends on the type|
|type|string|true|none|ACATS status discriminator value.|

```json
  "broker_name": "string",
  "broker_number": "string",
  "dtcc_reject_reason": "ACCOUNT_TITLE_MISMATCH",
  "dtcc_status": "REVIEW",
  "rejection_message": "string",
```
