}
```

Status details of the ACATS transfer at the time of the event.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broker_name|string|false|none|Name of the contra broker. Omitted if not available.|
|broker_number|string|false|none|DTCC participant number of the contra broker. Omitted if not available.|
|dtcc_reject_reason|string|false|none|Rejection reason, as returned by DTCC. Omitted if the transfer has not been rejected by DTCC. Uses the same values as `rejection_details.rejection_reason` on the ACATS transfer; DTCC system rejections may carry additional DTCC system reject reason codes, so treat unknown values as a generic rejection. May already be present on an `IN_PROGRESS` event, before the transfer is marked `REJECTED`.|
|dtcc_status|string|false|none|Transfer status as tracked by DTCC. Omitted until DTCC reports a status for the transfer. Usually one of the values of `status.dtcc_status` on the ACATS transfer; other values may appear, for example in sandbox, so treat unknown values as an intermediate status.|
|rejection_message|string|false|none|Human readable message regarding the reason for the rejection. Omitted if not available.|
|transfer_direction|[AdminActionAcatsTransferDirection](#schemaadminactionacatstransferdirection)|true|none|Direction of the ACATS transfer. `UNSPECIFIED` is sent when the direction is not known; use the ACATS endpoints to get the transfer direction.|
|transfer_status|string|true|none|Transfer status as tracked by Alpaca. Usually one of `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `REJECTED` or `SETTLED`, matching `status.transfer_status` on the ACATS transfer. Other values may appear in some cases, so treat unknown values as still in progress and use the ACATS endpoints for the current state.|
|transfer_type|[AdminActionAcatsTransferType](#schemaadminactionacatstransfertype)|true|none|Type of the ACATS transfer. Note this is a simplified classification and differs from the DTCC transfer type code (`FUL`, `PTR`, ...) returned as `transfer_type` by the ACATS endpoints. `UNSPECIFIED` is sent when the type is not known or does not map to one of the other values; use the ACATS endpoints to get the DTCC transfer type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|transfer_direction|INCOMING|
|transfer_direction|OUTGOING|
|transfer_direction|UNSPECIFIED|
|transfer_type|FULL|
|transfer_type|PARTIAL|
|transfer_type|RCR|
|transfer_type|UNSPECIFIED|

<h2 id="tocS_AdminConfigurations">AdminConfigurations</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadminconfigurations"></a>

<a id="tocSadminconfigurations"></a>

```json
{
  "acct_daily_transfer_limit": "string",
  "allow_instant_ach": true,
  "disable_algodash_access": true,
  "disable_api_key": true,
  "disable_crypto": true,
  "disable_day_trading": true,
  "disable_fractional": true,
  "disable_shorting": true,
  "incoming_transfers_blocked": true,
  "max_margin_multiplier": "string",
  "max_options_trading_level": 0,
  "outgoing_transfers_blocked": true,
  "restrict_to_liquidation_reasons": {
    "ach_return": true,
    "position_to_equity_ratio": true,
    "unspecified": true
  }
}
```

These configurations show account properties that are overridden either by Alpaca Broker Operations or an automated process.

These values cannot be modified by the Broker Partners.

This schema represents the current, effective value of each configuration (e.g. as returned by the get trading account endpoint). For the shape of the payloads broadcast by the **events** streaming API when these values change, see [AdminConfigurationsEvent](#/components/schemas/AdminConfigurationsEvent).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acct_daily_transfer_limit|string(decimal)|false|none|Override the correspondent level daily transfer limits|
|allow_instant_ach|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is allowed to perform instant ACH|
|disable_algodash_access|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is allowed to access algo dash|
|disable_api_key|boolean|false|none|If true, the account's API key will be disabled|
|disable_crypto|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is not allowed to trade cryptos|
|disable_day_trading|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is not allowed to day trade (e.g. buy and sell the same security on the same day)|
|disable_fractional|boolean|false|none|If true, the account cannot create orders for fractional share positions|
|disable_shorting|boolean|false|none|If true the account is not allowed to create short position orders|
|incoming_transfers_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true, incoming transfers to this account are rejected|
|max_margin_multiplier|string|false|none|The max margin multiplier set by admin for this account. Can be "1", "2", or "4".|
|max_options_trading_level|integer|false|none|The max options trading level set by admin for this account.<br>0=disabled, 1=Covered Call/Cash-Secured Put, 2=Long Call/Put, 3=Spreads/Straddles.<br>|
|outgoing_transfers_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true, outgoing transfers from this account are rejected|
|restrict_to_liquidation_reasons|[RestrictToLiquidationReasons](#schemarestricttoliquidationreasons)|false|none|Reasons why the liquidation only flag was set|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|

|max_options_trading_level|1|
|max_options_trading_level|2|
|max_options_trading_level|3|

<h2 id="tocS_AdminConfigurationsEvent">AdminConfigurationsEvent</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadminconfigurationsevent"></a>
<a id="schema_AdminConfigurationsEvent"></a>
<a id="tocSadminconfigurationsevent"></a>
<a id="tocsadminconfigurationsevent"></a>

```json
{
  "acct_daily_transfer_limit": {
    "from": "string",
    "to": "string"
  },
  "allow_instant_ach": true,
  "disable_algodash_access": true,
  "disable_api_key": true,
  "disable_crypto": true,
  "disable_day_trading": true,
  "disable_fractional": true,
  "disable_shorting": true,
  "incoming_transfers_blocked": true,
  "max_margin_multiplier": {
    "from": "string",
    "to": "string"
  },
  "max_options_trading_level": {
    "from": "string",
    "to": "string"
  },
  "outgoing_transfers_blocked": true,
  "restrict_to_liquidation_reasons": {
    "ach_return": true,
    "position_to_equity_ratio": true,
    "unspecified": true
  }
}
```

Represents a change to admin configurations, as broadcast over the **events** streaming API. Only fields whose value changed are included; unrelated update events will not include a flag that did not change.

Depending on the type of the Admin Configuration, the sent event will behave differently. For bool flags we are only sending the new value.

For example, the following payload means that the disable_shorting flag was set to true:

```
{
  "disable_shorting": true
}
```

For other data types, we are embedding the old and new values into the payload. For example changing the max_margin_multiplier from 4 to 1 will yield this payload:

```
{
  "max_margin_multiplier": {
    "from": 4,
    "to": 1
  }
}
```

Introducing an override value from the default will yield a null value as `from`. For example restricting the max_margin_multiplier to 1 from default will yield the following payload:

```
{
  "max_margin_multiplier": {
    "from": null,
    "to": 1
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acct_daily_transfer_limit|object|false|none|The correspondent level daily transfer limit override was changed|
|allow_instant_ach|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is allowed to perform instant ACH|
|disable_algodash_access|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is allowed to access algo dash|
|disable_api_key|boolean|false|none|If true, the account's API key will be disabled|
|disable_crypto|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is not allowed to trade cryptos|
|disable_day_trading|boolean|false|none|If true, the account is not allowed to day trade (e.g. buy and sell the same security on the same day)|
|disable_fractional|boolean|false|none|If true, the account cannot create orders for fractional share positions|
|disable_shorting|boolean|false|none|If true the account is not allowed to create short position orders|
|incoming_transfers_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true, incoming transfers to this account are rejected|
|max_margin_multiplier|object|false|none|Max margin multiplier was changed by admin to this value|
|max_options_trading_level|object|false|none|Max options trading level was changed by admin to this value. It can be 0, 1, 2, or 3.|
|outgoing_transfers_blocked|boolean|false|none|If true, outgoing transfers from this account are rejected|
|restrict_to_liquidation_reasons|[RestrictToLiquidationReasons](#schemarestricttoliquidationreasons)|false|none|Reasons why the liquidation only flag was set|

<h2 id="tocS_Announcement">Announcement</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaannouncement"></a>
<a id="schema_Announcement"></a>
<a id="tocSannouncement"></a>
<a id="tocsannouncement"></a>

```json
{
  "ca_sub_type": "cash",
  "ca_type": "dividend",
  "cash": "0",
  "corporate_action_id": "78467X109_AA22",
  "declaration_date": "2021-12-19",
  "ex_date": "2022-01-21",
  "id": "bebc5ece-34be-47e9-b944-687e69a102be",
  "initiating_original_cusip": "252787106",
  "initiating_symbol": "DIA",
  "new_rate": "1",
  "old_rate": "1",
  "payable_date": "2022-02-14",
  "record_date": "2022-01-24",
  "target_original_cusip": "252787106",
  "target_symbol": "DIA"
}
```

The announcements endpoint contains public information on previous and upcoming dividends, mergers, spinoffs, and stock splits.

Announcement data is made available through the API as soon as it is ingested by Alpaca, which is typically the following trading day after the declaration date. This provides insight into future account stock position and cash balance changes that will take effect on an announcement's payable date. Additionally, viewing previous announcement details can improve bookkeeping and reconciling previous account cash and position changes.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ca_sub_type|[AnnouncementCASubType](#schemaannouncementcasubtype)|true|none|Announcements have both a type and a subtype to categorize them. This model represents the lower level abstract "sub types" of Announcement. Please see the AnnouncementCAType model for higher level descriptions of the possible types<br><br>Possible values are:<br><br>- from the `dividend` type:<br>  - **cash**<br><br>    A cash payment based on the number of shares the account holds on the record date.<br>  - **stock**<br><br>    A stock payment based on the number of shares the account holds on the record date.<br><br>- from the `merger` type:<br>  - **merger_update**<br><br>    An update to the terms of an upcoming merger. This can happen any number of times before the merger is completed and can be tracked by using the id parameter.<br><br>  - **merger_completion**<br><br>    A final update in the terms of the merger in which the initiating_symbol will acquire the target_symbol. Any previous terms updates for this announcement will have the same id value.<br><br>- from the `split` type:<br>  - **stock_split**<br><br>    An increase in the number of shares outstanding with a decrease in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.<br>  - **until_split**<br><br>    An increase in the number of shares outstanding with a decrease in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.<br>  - **reverse_split**<br><br>    A decrease in the number of shares outstanding with an increase in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.<br>  - **recapitalization**<br><br>    A stock recapitalization, typically used by a company to adjust debt and equity ratios.<br><br>- from the `spinoff` type:<br>  - **spinoff**<br><br>    A disbursement of a newly tradable security when the initiating_symbol creates the target_symbol.|

A disbursement of a newly tradable security when the initiating_symbol creates the target_symbol.|

<h2 id="tocS_AnnouncementCASubType">AnnouncementCASubType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaannouncementcasubtype"></a>
<a id="schema_AnnouncementCASubType"></a>
<a id="tocSannouncementcasubtype"></a>
<a id="tocsannouncementcasubtype"></a>

```json
"cash"
```

Announcements have both a type and a subtype to categorize them. This model represents the lower level abstract "sub types" of Announcement. Please see the AnnouncementCAType model for higher level descriptions of the possible types

Possible values are:

- from the `dividend` type:
  - **cash**

    A cash payment based on the number of shares the account holds on the record date.
  - **stock**

    A stock payment based on the number of shares the account holds on the record date.

- from the `merger` type:
  - **merger_update**

    An update to the terms of an upcoming merger. This can happen any number of times before the merger is completed and can be tracked by using the id parameter.

  - **merger_completion**

    A final update in the terms of the merger in which the initiating_symbol will acquire the target_symbol. Any previous terms updates for this announcement will have the same id value.

- from the `split` type:
  - **stock_split**

    An increase in the number of shares outstanding with a decrease in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.
  - **until_split**

    An increase in the number of shares outstanding with a decrease in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.
  - **reverse_split**

    A decrease in the number of shares outstanding with an increase in the dollar value of each share. The new_rate and old_rate parameters will be returned in order to derive the ratio of the split.
  - **recapitalization**

    A stock recapitalization, typically used by a company to adjust debt and equity ratios.

- from the `spinoff` type:
  - **spinoff**

    A disbursement of a newly tradable security when the initiating_symbol creates the target_symbol.

<h2 id="tocS_AnnouncementCAType">AnnouncementCAType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaannouncementcatype"></a>
<a id="schema_AnnouncementCAType"></a>
<a id="tocSannouncementcatype"></a>
<a id="tocsannouncementcatype"></a>

```json
"dividend"
```

Announcements have both a type and a subtype to categorize them. This model represents the higher level abstract "types" of Announcement. Please see the AnnouncementCASubType model for finer grain descriptions of the subtypes

Possible values are:
- dividend
  can have `cash` and `stock` subtypes
- merger
  has `merger_update` and `merger_completion` sub types
- split
  has `stock_split`, `until_split`, `reverse_split`, and `recapitalization` sub types
- spinoff
  currently has only the `spinoff` subtype and thus is just this higher level category for now. A disbursement of a newly tradable security when the initiating_symbol creates the target_symbol.

Assets are sorted by asset class, exchange and symbol. Some assets are not tradable with Alpaca. These assets will be marked with the flag tradable=false

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attributes|[string]|false|none|Unique characteristics of the asset. Supported values:<br>- `ptp_no_exception`: Asset is a Publicly Traded Partnership (PTP) without a qualified notice; non-U.S. customers may incur 10% withholding on gross proceeds as per IRS guidance, and are blocked from being purchased by default.<br>- `ptp_with_exception`: Users can open positions in these PTPs without general restrictions.<br>- `ipo`: Accepting limit orders only before the stock begins trading on the secondary market.<br>- `has_options`: The underlying equity has listed options available on the platform. Note: if the equity had inactive/expired contracts in the past, this will still show up.<br>- `options_late_close`: Indicates the underlying asset's options contracts close at 4:15pm ET instead of the standard 4:00pm ET.<br>- `fractional_eh_enabled`: Indicates the asset accepts fractional orders during extended hours sessions (pre-market, post-market, and overnight if enabled).<br>- `overnight_tradable`: Asset is eligible for overnight (24x5) trading in supported venues on the platform.<br>- `overnight_halted`: Asset is eligible for overnight trading but is currently halted/blocked for overnight sessions due to risk, corporate action, compliance, or venue constraints.|
|borrow_status|string|false|none|Borrow status for US equity assets. This field is omitted for non-US-equity assets.|
|class|[AssetClass](#schemaassetclass)|true|none|This represents the category to which the asset belongs to. It serves to identify the nature of the financial instrument, with options including "us_equity" for U.S. equities, "us_option" for U.S. options, "crypto" for cryptocurrencies, and "ipo" for IPO indications of interest. This `asset_class: ipo` value is distinct from the assets API `attributes: ["ipo"]` flag.|
|exchange|[Exchange](#schemaexchange)|true|none|Represents the exchange where an asset is traded.<br><br>For Stocks:<br>- AMEX<br>- ARCA<br>- BATS<br>- NYSE<br>- NASDAQ<br>- NYSEARCA<br>- OTC<br>- TXSE<br><br>For Crypto:<br>- CRYPTO<br>- ERSX<br>- CRXL<br><br>For crypto perpetuals:<br>- ASCX<br><br>Index symbols:<br>- INDEX<br><br>INDEX is the artificial exchange for index symbols such as SPX.|
|fractionable|boolean|true|none|Asset is fractionable or not|
|id|string(uuid)|true|none|Asset ID|
|maintenance_margin_requirement|number|false|none|**Deprecated.** **deprecated**: Please use margin_requirement_long or margin_requirement_short instead. Note that these fields are of type string.<br>Shows the margin requirement percentage for the asset (equities only).<br>|
|margin_requirement_long|string(decimal)|true|none|The margin requirement percentage for the asset's long positions (equities only), encoded as a decimal string.|
|margin_requirement_short|string(decimal)|true|none|The margin requirement percentage for the asset's short positions (equities only), encoded as a decimal string.|
|marginable|boolean|true|none|Asset is marginable or not|
|min_order_size|string|false|none|Minimum order size.  Field available for crypto only.|
|min_trade_increment|string|false|none|Amount a trade quantity can be incremented by. Field available for crypto only.|
|name|string|true|none|The official name of the asset|
|price_increment|string|false|none|Amount the price can be incremented by. Field available for crypto only.|
|shortable|boolean|true|none|Asset is shortable or not|
|status|string|true|none|active or inactive|
|symbol|string|true|none|The symbol of the asset|
|tradable|boolean|true|none|Asset is tradable on Alpaca or not|

This represents the category to which the asset belongs to. It serves to identify the nature of the financial instrument, with options including "us_equity" for U.S. equities, "us_option" for U.S. options, "crypto" for cryptocurrencies, and "ipo" for IPO indications of interest. This `asset_class: ipo` value is distinct from the assets API `attributes: ["ipo"]` flag.

Journal is not processed yet.<br><br>sent_to_clearing	Journal sent to be processed by Alpaca's booking system. The journal is not processed yet.<br><br>pending	    Journal pending to be processed as it requires manual approval from Alpaca operations (for example due to hitting JNLC daily limits).<br><br>executed	Journal executed and balances updated for both sides of <br>the journal transaction. Please try again.<br><br>canceled	Journal canceled. This is a **FINAL** status.<br><br>refused	Journal refused. Please try again.<br><br>deleted	Journal deleted. This is a **FINAL** status.<br><br>correct	Journal is corrected. Previously executed journal is cancelled and a new journal is corrected amount is created. This is a **FINAL** status.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The creation time when supplied by the endpoint.|
|currency|string|true|none|Currency denomination of the journal.|
|description|string|true|none|The journal description.|
|from_account|string(uuid)|true|none|The account ID that initiated the journal.|
|id|string(uuid)|true|none|The journal ID.|
|net_amount|string \| null(decimal)|true|none|The cash amount, or null when not applicable.|
|price|string \| null(decimal)|true|none|The journaled security price, or null when not applicable.|
|qty|string \| null(decimal)|true|none|The journaled security quantity, or null when not applicable.|
|settle_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The settlement date, or null until one is assigned.|
|status|[JournalStatus](#schemajournalstatus)|true|none|Represents the status that a Journal instance can be in.<br><br>**Current Values**<br><br>queued	Journal in queue to be processed. Journal is not processed yet.<br><br>sent_to_clearing	Journal sent to be processed by Alpaca's booking system. The journal is not processed yet.<br><br>pending	    Journal pending to be processed as it requires manual approval from Alpaca operations (for example due to hitting JNLC daily limits).<br><br>executed	Journal executed and balances updated for both sides of <br>the journal transaction. This is not a final status, journals can be reversed if there is an error.<br><br>activity_created	Non-trade activity has been created for journal (JNLC v2-only).<br><br>rejected	Journal rejected. Please try again.<br><br>canceled	Journal canceled. This is a **FINAL** status.<br><br>refused	Journal refused. Please try again.<br><br>deleted	Journal deleted. This is a **FINAL** status.<br><br>correct	Journal is corrected. Previously executed journal is cancelled and a new journal is corrected amount is created. This is a **FINAL** status.|
|symbol|string \| null|true|none|The journaled security symbol, or null for a cash journal.|
|system_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The booking-system date, or null until one is assigned.|
|to_account|string(uuid)|true|none|The account ID that received the journal.|
|transmitter_info|[TransmitterInfo](#schematransmitterinfo)|false|none|Information about the transmitter to satisfy travel rule requirements. Required if the requesting correspondent qualifies as a financial institution<br>|
|entry_type|string|true|none|Securities journal discriminator value.|
|error_message|string|false|none|Description of why this journal transaction failed. Omitted for successful results.|

|relationship|string|true|none|Relationship of the beneficiary to the account holder.|
|share_pct|string(decimal)|true|none|Share of the account allocated to this beneficiary, as a decimal string. The value must be greater than 0 and at most 100, with at most two decimal places.<br>|
|tax_id|string|true|none|Beneficiary tax identifier. Create and update requests require a USA SSN. Account responses always return the masked value `xxx-xx-xxxx`.<br>|
|tax_id_type|string|true|none|Tax identifier type.|
|type|string|true|none|Whether this beneficiary is primary or contingent. An account with beneficiaries needs at least one primary beneficiary. The `share_pct` values of all primary beneficiaries must add up to 100, and the `share_pct` values of all contingent beneficiaries, if any, must also add up to 100.<br>|

|Property|Value|

|relationship|other|
|tax_id_type|USA_SSN|
|type|primary|
|type|contingent|

<h2 id="tocS_CommissionType">CommissionType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacommissiontype"></a>
<a id="schema_CommissionType"></a>
<a id="tocScommissiontype"></a>
<a id="tocscommissiontype"></a>

```json
"qty"
```

An enum to select how to interpret the value provided in the commission field.

- notional:
Charge commission on a per order basis. (When the `commission_type` field is omitted from the order request, this is used as the default).

- qty:
Charge commission on a per qty/contract basis, pro rated.

- bps:
The percent commission you want to charge the end user on the order (expressed in bps). Alpaca will convert the order to a notional amount for purposes of calculating commission.
Commission value in bps can have up to two decimal places.

<h2 id="tocS_CommonFixedIncomeInterestActivityV2">CommonFixedIncomeInterestActivityV2</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacommonfixedincomeinterestactivityv2"></a>
<a id="schema_CommonFixedIncomeInterestActivityV2"></a>
<a id="tocScommonfixedincomeinterestactivityv2"></a>
<a id="tocscommonfixedincomeinterestactivityv2"></a>

```json
{
  "accrued_interest_rate": "string",
  "cash_payout": "string",
  "cusip": "string",
  "entitled_qty": "1000",
  "interest_type": "accrued",
  "isin": "string",
  "order_id": "257bf308-a6b7-4777-8cf6-00dc441dc4d3",
  "parent_id": "46aecae1-4629-4bcf-b441-0d8c847a1787",
  "payment_date": "1970-01-01",
  "price": "string",
  "rate": "string",
  "record_date": "1970-01-01"
}
```

Fixed income interest fields (INT/FI). Variants from the same activity type:

- Coupon: `interest_type` is `coupon`. Includes `rate` (no `price` / `accrued_interest_rate`). No `order_id`.
- Accrued interest on call: `interest_type` is `accrued`. Includes `price` and `accrued_interest_rate` (no `rate`). No `order_id`.
- Trade accrued: `interest_type` is `accrued`. Includes `order_id` so the interest NTA can be linked to the fill. `parent_id` is set when a parent trade `ref_id` is available.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accrued_interest_rate|string(decimal)|false|none|Accrued interest rate (present for accrued-interest-on-call variants)|
|cash_payout|string(decimal)|true|none|The cash payout for this interest activity|
|cusip|string|true|none|The CUSIP of the security involved with the activity|
|entitled_qty|string|true|none|The entitled quantity (principal / face amount)|
|interest_type|[FixedIncomeInterestType](#schemafixedincomeinteresttype)|true|none|Distinguishes coupon payments from accrued interest on INT/FI activities.|
|isin|string|false|none|The ISIN of the security involved with the activity|
|order_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The order that generated this accrued interest. Present for trade-accrued INT/FI.|
|parent_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The ref_id of the parent trade this interest is attached to. Present for trade-accrued INT/FI when a parent trade `ref_id` is available.|
|payment_date|string(date)|false|none|The payment date|
|price|string(decimal)|false|none|Call price used for accrued-interest-on-call variants|
|rate|string(decimal)|false|none|Coupon rate amount (present for regular coupon payments)|
|record_date|string(date)|false|none|The record date|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|interest_type|coupon|
|interest_type|accrued|

This is a sum type with two variants:

<h2 id="tocS_CreateJournalRequest">CreateJournalRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreatejournalrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_CreateJournalRequest"></a>
<a id="tocScreatejournalrequest"></a>
<a id="tocscreatejournalrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "amount": "51",
  "description": "Move cash to a customer account",
  "entry_type": "JNLC",
  "from_account": "7c891489-574f-4f9a-82f0-4082a07f4736",
  "to_account": "2d47a229-0c25-40a2-8cc7-b2c8821ff93a"
}
```

Journals API allows you to move cash or securities from one account to another.

This model represents the fields you can specify when creating a Journal

Fixture Rules

- No Fixtures
  - anything below limit is executed immediately
  - anything above limit is pending until executed at EOD,
- With Fixtures
  - any status = rejected will be rejected EOD
  - any status = pending will be pending forever

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|string|false|none|Required if `entry_type` = `JNLC`|
|currency|string|false|none|The currency of the journal. Defaults to the system currency (for example, USD in the US or EUR in the EU) when omitted. Correspondents with local currency trading enabled must send this field, and the value must be the system currency or one of the correspondent's enabled currencies|
|description|string|false|none|Max 1024 characters. Can include fixtures for amounts that are above the transaction limit|
|entry_type|[JournalEntryType](#schemajournalentrytype)|true|none|This enum represents the various kinds of Journal alpaca supports.<br><br>Current values are:<br><br>- **JNLC**<br><br>  Journal Cash between accounts<br><br>- **JNLS**<br><br>  Journal Securities between accounts|
|from_account|string(uuid)|true|none|The account_id you wish to journal from|
|qty|string|false|none|Required if `entry_type` = `JNLS`|
|symbol|string|false|none|Required if `entry_type` = `JNLS`|
|to_account|string(uuid)|true|none|The account_id you wish to journal to|
|transmitter_account_number|string|false|none|Max 255 characters. See more details about [Travel Rule](https://alpaca.markets/docs/broker/integration/funding/#travel-rule) in our main documentation.|
|transmitter_address|string|false|none|Max 255 characters. See more details about [Travel Rule](https://alpaca.markets/docs/broker/integration/funding/#travel-rule) in our main documentation.|
|transmitter_financial_institution|string|false|none|Max 255 characters. See more details about [Travel Rule](https://alpaca.markets/docs/broker/integration/funding/#travel-rule) in our main documentation.|
|transmitter_name|string|false|none|Max 255 characters. See more details about [Travel Rule](https://alpaca.markets/docs/broker/integration/funding/#travel-rule) in our main documentation.|
|transmitter_timestamp|string(date-time)|false|none|RFC 3339 format. See more details about [Travel Rule](https://alpaca.markets/docs/broker/integration/funding/#travel-rule) in our main documentation.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|entry_type|JNLC|
|entry_type|JNLS|

  },

  "subtag": "string",
  "swap_fee_bps": "string",
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "take_profit": {
    "limit_price": "3.14"
  },
  "time_in_force": "gtc",
  "trail_percent": "5.0",
  "trail_price": "3.14",
  "type": "market"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advanced_instructions|[AdvancedInstructions](#schemaadvancedinstructions)|false|none|Advanced instructions for Direct Market Access (DMA) routing. When `algorithm` is `DMA`,<br>the order is routed directly to the exchange specified in `destination`. Note that this feature is only<br>available to partners/correspondents who have been enabled for DMA.|
|client_order_id|string|false|none|A unique identifier for the order. Automatically generated if not sent. (<= 128 characters)|
|commission|string(decimal)|false|none|The commission you want to collect from the user.|
|commission_bps|string(decimal)|false|none|**Deprecated.** **deprecated**: Please use the commission_type = bps instead and set the desired bps value in the `commission` field.<br>The percent commission you want to charge the end user on the order (expressed in bps). Alpaca will convert the order to a notional amount for purposes of calculating commission.<br>|
|commission_type|[CommissionType](#schemacommissiontype)|false|none|An enum to select how to interpret the value provided in the commission field.<br><br>- notional:<br>Charge commission on a per order basis. (When the `commission_type` field is omitted from the order request, this is used as the default).<br><br>- qty:<br>Charge commission on a per qty/contract basis, pro rated.<br><br>- bps:<br>The percent commission you want to charge the end user on the order (expressed in bps). Alpaca will convert the order to a notional amount for purposes of calculating commission.<br>Commission value in bps can have up to two decimal places.|
|extended_hours|boolean|false|none|Defaults to false. If true, order will be eligible for execution in the pre-market, after-hours, and overnight sessions. Only works with type `limit` and time_in_force set to either `day` or `gtc`.|
|instructions|string|false|none|none|
|legs|[[MLegOrderLeg](#schemamlegorderleg)]|false|none|list of order legs (<= 4)|
|limit_price|string(decimal)|false|none|Required if type is `limit` or `stop_limit`.<br>- In case of `mleg`, the limit_price parameter is expressed with the following notation:<br>  - A positive value indicates a debit, representing a cost or payment to be made.<br>  - A negative value signifies a credit, reflecting an amount to be received.<br>- In case of Fixed Income, the price is expressed in percentage of par value (face value).<br>Price is always clean price, meaning it does not include accrued interest.|
|notional|string(decimal)|false|none|Dollar amount to trade. Cannot work with qty. Only market and limit orders supported with time_in_force = day; Only limit orders for extended hours.|
|order_class|[OrderClass](#schemaorderclass)|false|none|The order classes supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. The following provides a comprehensive breakdown of the supported order classes for each category:<br>  - Equity trading: simple (or ""), oco, oto, bracket.<br>  - Options trading:<br>    - simple (or "")<br>    - mleg (required for multi-leg complex option strategies)<br>  - Crypto trading: simple (or "").|
|position_intent|[PositionIntent](#schemapositionintent)|false|none|Represents the desired position strategy.|
|qty|string(decimal)|false|none|- For equities, the number of shares to trade. Can be fractionable for only market and day order types.<br>- Required for `mleg` order class, represents the number of units to trade of this strategy.<br>- For Fixed Income securities, qty represents the order size in par value (face value).<br>For example, to place an order for 1 bond with a face value of $1,000, provide a qty of 1000.<br>|
|side|[OrderSide](#schemaorderside)|false|none|Represents what side of the transaction an order was on. Required for all order classes except for `mleg`.|
|source|string|false|none|none|
|stop_loss|object|false|none|Takes in a string/number values for stop_price and limit_price|
|stop_price|string(decimal)|false|none|Required if type is stop or stop_limit|
|subtag|string|false|none|none|
|swap_fee_bps|string(decimal)|false|none|none|
|symbol|string|false|none|Symbol or asset ID to identify the asset to trade. Required for all order classes except for `mleg`.|
|take_profit|object|false|none|Takes in a string/number value for limit_price|
|time_in_force|[TimeInForce](#schematimeinforce)|true|none|The Time-In-Force values supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. Here is a breakdown of the supported TIFs for each specific security type:<br>- Equity trading: day, gtc, opg, cls, ioc, fok.<br>- Options trading: day, gtc.<br>- Crypto trading: gtc, ioc.<br><br>Below are the descriptions of each TIF:<br>- day:<br>  A day order is eligible for execution only on the day it is live. By default, the order is only valid during Regular Trading Hours (9:30am - 4:00pm ET). If unfilled after the closing auction, it is automatically canceled. If submitted after the close, it is queued and submitted the following trading day. However, if marked as eligible for extended hours, the order can also execute during supported extended hours.<br><br>- gtc:<br>  The order is good until canceled. Non-marketable GTC limit orders are subject to price adjustments to offset corporate actions affecting the issue. We do not currently support Do Not Reduce (DNR) orders to opt out of such price adjustments.<br><br>- opg:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on open" (MOO) and "limit on open" (LOO) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market opening auction. Any unfilled orders after the open will be cancelled. OPG orders submitted after 9:28am but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. OPG orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's opening auction. On open/on close orders are routed to the primary exchange. Such orders do not necessarily execute exactly at 9:30am / 4:00pm ET but execute per the exchange's auction rules.<br><br>- cls:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on close" (MOC) and "limit on close" (LOC) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market closing auction. Any unfilled orders after the close will be cancelled. CLS orders submitted after 3:50pm but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. CLS orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's closing auction.<br><br>- ioc:<br>  An Immediate Or Cancel (IOC) order requires all or part of the order to be executed immediately. Any unfilled portion of the order is canceled. Most market makers who receive IOC orders will attempt to fill the order on a principal basis only, and cancel any unfilled balance. On occasion, this can result in the entire order being cancelled if the market maker does not have any existing inventory of the security in question.<br><br>- fok:<br>  A Fill or Kill (FOK) order is only executed if the entire order quantity can be filled, otherwise the order is canceled.|
|trail_percent|string(decimal)|false|none|If type is trailing_stop, then one of trail_price or trail_percent is required|
|trail_price|string(decimal)|false|none|If type is trailing_stop, then one of trail_price or trail_percent is required|
|type|[OrderType](#schemaordertype)|true|none|The order types supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. The following provides a comprehensive breakdown of the supported order types for each category:<br> - Equity trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit, trailing_stop.<br> - Options trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit.<br> - Options Multileg trading: market, limit.<br> - Crypto trading: market, limit, stop_limit.|

<h2 id="tocS_CustodialAccountType">CustodialAccountType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacustodialaccounttype"></a>
<a id="schema_CustodialAccountType"></a>
<a id="tocScustodialaccounttype"></a>
<a id="tocscustodialaccounttype"></a>

```json
"string"
```

Represents the type of custodial account based on the state where the beneficiary resides.
This value is returned only when the `country_of_tax_residence` is `USA`. For other countries, this property is not included in the response.

**Possible Return Values**

`CustodianTypeUTMA` - Indicates that the custodial account is governed by the Uniform Transfers to Minors Act.
`CustodianTypeUGMA` - Indicates that the custodial account is governed by the Uniform Gifts to Minors Act.

<h2 id="tocS_DailyTradingLimit">DailyTradingLimit</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadailytradinglimit"></a>
<a id="schema_DailyTradingLimit"></a>
<a id="tocSdailytradinglimit"></a>
<a id="tocsdailytradinglimit"></a>

```json
{
  "cash_held": "20000",
  "correspondent": "EXMP",
  "daily_net_limit": "1000000",
  "executed_buys": "55",
  "executed_sells": "0",
  "in_use_limit": "55",
  "open_buys": "0",
  "open_sells": "0"
}
```

Correspondent-level daily net buying limit and the real-time amount currently consuming it.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cash_held|string(decimal)|false|none|Cash reserved for open cash-secured put positions. Only present in the response when the correspondent has at least one open cash-secured put; the field is omitted from the response otherwise (including for options-enabled correspondents with no open cash-secured puts).|
|correspondent|string|false|none|The correspondent code the limits apply to.|
|daily_net_limit|string(decimal)|false|none|The daily net buying limit for the correspondent; further buying is halted once the in_use_limit limit reaches this value.|
|executed_buys|string(decimal)|false|none|Cumulative cash value of executed buy activity contributing to the in-use limit since the last reset.|
|executed_sells|string(decimal)|false|none|Cumulative cash value of executed sell activity offsetting the in-use limit since the last reset.|
|in_use_limit|string(decimal)|false|none|Real-time net amount currently consuming the daily limit. Equal to `executed_buys` − `executed_sells` + `open_buys` − `open_sells` (+ `cash_held` when a cash-secured put is open). Resets at the start of the next trading day at 8.00 PM ET.|
|open_buys|string(decimal)|false|none|Reserved cash value of currently open buy orders (limit price for limit orders, notional or estimated mid for market orders) contributing to the in-use limit.|
|open_sells|string(decimal)|false|none|Reserved cash value of currently open sell orders offsetting the in-use limit.|

{
  "immediate_family_exposed": false,
  "is_affiliated_exchange_or_finra": false,
  "is_control_person": false,
  "is_politically_exposed": false
}
```

Disclosures fields denote if the account owner falls under
each category defined by FINRA rule. The client has to ask
questions for the end user and the values should reflect
their answers.
If one of the answers is true (yes), the account goes into
ACTION_REQUIRED status.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|context|[[DisclosureContextAnnotation](#schemadisclosurecontextannotation)]|false|none|Array of annotations describing the rationale for marking `is_control_person`, `is_affiliated_exchange_or_finra`, and/or `immediate_family_exposed` as true|
|employer_address|string|false|none|The employer's address if the user is employed.|
|employer_name|string|false|none|The name of the employer if the user is employed.|
|employment_position|string|false|none|The user's position if they are employed.|
|employment_sector|string|false|none|The industry sector of employment.<br>If the `employment_status` is `unemployed` or `student`, set this property to `not_employed`.<br>If the `employment_status` is `retired`, set this to `self_employed`.<br>|
|employment_status|string|false|none|One of the following: `employed`, `unemployed`, `retired`, or `student`.|
|immediate_family_exposed|boolean|true|none|If your user's immediate family member (sibling, husband/wife, child, parent) is either politically exposed or holds a control position.|
|is_affiliated_exchange_or_finra|boolean|true|none|Whether user is affiliated with any exchanges or FINRA.|
|is_control_person|boolean|true|none|Whether user holds a controlling position in a publicly traded company, member of the board of directors or has policy making abilities in a publicly traded company.|
|is_politically_exposed|boolean|true|none|Whether the user is politically exposed.|

<h2 id="tocS_IPOEvent">IPOEvent</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaipoevent"></a>
<a id="schema_IPOEvent"></a>
<a id="tocSipoevent"></a>
<a id="tocsipoevent"></a>

```json
{
  "at": "2026-03-20T12:24:58.807230Z",
  "event_id": "01J9RPMV5TKB8WX3M4F1KZ7QH2",
  "offering_reference": "FI111225",
  "payload": {
    "available_to_order": "Available",
    "max_price": "42",
    "min_price": "42",
    "name": "Example Corp",
    "source": "example source",
    "ticker_symbol": "EXMP"
  },
  "received_at": "2026-03-20T12:24:58.500000Z",
  "verb": "Offering"
}
```

Represents an IPO offering lifecycle event delivered over the IPO events streaming API (`/v2/events/ipos`).

IPO events come in six `verb` types:
- **`Offering`** - initial publication of an offering. The `payload` carries `name`, `available_to_order`, `ticker_symbol`, `min_price`, `max_price` (and optional `source`).
- **`OfferingUpdate`** - update to a previously published offering. The `payload` shape is identical to `Offering`.
- **`Prospectus`** - prospectus document is now available. The `payload` carries `prospectus_url` and `subject`.
- **`SixtyMinMail`** - 60-minute pricing window has opened, no new orders accepted. The `payload` carries `sixty_minute_expiration_time` and `subject`.
- **`Allocation`** - final allocation result for a specific account. The `payload` carries `cusip_id`, `final_price`, `allocated_shares`, `allocated_amount`, `subject`. **This is the only verb that is account-scoped**: `account_id` and `correspondent` are populated.
- **`OfferingCancellation`** - offering was cancelled. **No `payload` is present.**

See the example payloads below for a concrete example per verb.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The account this event applies to. Only populated for `Allocation` events; omitted for system-wide verbs (`Offering`, `OfferingUpdate`, `Prospectus`, `SixtyMinMail`, `OfferingCancellation`).<br>|
|at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp the event was emitted by the streaming service.|
|correspondent|string|false|none|The correspondent that owns the account. Only populated for `Allocation` events.<br>|
|event_id|string(ulid)|true|none|Lexically sortable, monotonically increasing identifier for this event. Use this value with `since_id`/`until_id` to resume the stream from a known point.|
|offering_reference|string|true|none|The IPO offering this event refers to. Use this value with `GET /v1/ipos/{offering_reference}` to fetch the full offering metadata.<br>|
|payload|object|false|none|Verb-specific payload. The shape varies by `verb` - see schema description and `components/examples` for the structure of each. **Omitted entirely for `OfferingCancellation`.**<br>|
|received_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp the upstream event was first received by Alpaca's IPO ingestion pipeline (before fanout).|
|verb|string|true|none|The IPO event type. Determines the shape of `payload`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|verb|Allocation|
|verb|Offering|
|verb|OfferingUpdate|
|verb|Prospectus|
|verb|SixtyMinMail|
|verb|OfferingCancellation|

<h2 id="tocS_IPOOffering">IPOOffering</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaipooffering"></a>
<a id="schema_IPOOffering"></a>
<a id="tocSipooffering"></a>
<a id="tocsipooffering"></a>

```json
{
  "anticipated_shares": 0,
  "availability": "available",
  "cusip_id": "123456789",
  "description": "string",
  "ipo_reference": "FI111225",
  "logo_small": "string",
  "max_price": "42",
  "max_ticket_size": "string",
  "min_price": "42",
  "min_ticket_size": "string",
  "name": "Example Corp",
  "no_new_orders": false,
  "offering_type": "IPO",
  "prospectus_url": "string",
  "settlement_date": "1970-01-01",
  "ticker_symbol": "EXMP",
  "trade_date": "1970-01-01",
  "underwriters": [
    "string"
  ],
  "unit_step_size": "string"
}
```

An IPO (Initial Public Offering) offering exposed via the IPO discovery REST API. Returned by `GET /v1/ipos` and `GET /v1/ipos/{offering_reference}`.

Most IPO lifecycle changes (new offerings, prospectus availability, 60-minute mail, allocations, cancellations) are pushed in real time over the [IPO Events Stream](#operation/subscribeToIPOEventsSSE).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|anticipated_shares|integer(int64)|false|none|Anticipated total share count for the offering, when known.|
|availability|string|true|none|Whether the offering is currently accepting orders.<br>- `available` - accepting new orders.<br>- `not_available` - not yet open for orders.<br>- `closed` - no longer accepting orders.<br><br>Note: the IPO Events Stream uses a different casing for the analogous `payload.available_to_order` field on `Offering`/`OfferingUpdate` events (`Available`, `NotAvailable`, `Closed`).<br>|
|cusip_id|string|false|none|CUSIP identifier of the offering.|
|description|string|false|none|A longer human-readable description of the offering, when available.|
|ipo_reference|string|true|none|The unique offering identifier used across the IPO Events Stream and `/v1/ipos/{offering_reference}`. Note that this value is also used as the path parameter, where it is named `offering_reference`.<br>|
|logo_small|string|false|none|URL to a small logo asset for the issuer.|
|max_price|string(decimal)|true|none|Upper bound of the indicated price range.|
|max_ticket_size|string|false|none|Maximum allowed order amount.|
|min_price|string(decimal)|true|none|Lower bound of the indicated price range.|
|min_ticket_size|string|false|none|Minimum allowed order amount.|
|name|string|true|none|The official name of the offering.|
|no_new_orders|boolean|true|none|When `true`, the offering is in its 60-minute pricing window and is not accepting new orders. This mirrors the `SixtyMinMail` event on the IPO Events Stream.<br>|
|offering_type|string|true|none|The type of offering. Currently always `IPO`.|
|prospectus_url|string|false|none|URL to the prospectus document. Mirrors the `prospectus_url` payload of the corresponding `Prospectus` event on the IPO Events Stream.<br>|
|settlement_date|string(date)|false|none|Anticipated settlement date.|
|ticker_symbol|string|false|none|The ticker symbol that will be used once the security begins trading on the secondary market.|
|trade_date|string(date)|false|none|Anticipated first trading date on the secondary market.|
|underwriters|[string]|false|none|List of underwriter names participating in the offering.|
|unit_step_size|string|false|none|The minimum increment in which order quantities can be specified.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|availability|available|
|availability|not_available|
|availability|closed|

<h2 id="tocS_JournalStatus">JournalStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemajournalstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_JournalStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSjournalstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsjournalstatus"></a>

```json
"pending"
```

Represents the status that a Journal instance can be in.

**Current Values**

queued	Journal in queue to be processed. Journal is not processed yet.

sent_to_clearing	Journal sent to be processed by Alpaca's booking system. The journal is not processed yet.

pending	    Journal pending to be processed as it requires manual approval from Alpaca operations (for example due to hitting JNLC daily limits).

executed	Journal executed and balances updated for both sides of 
the journal transaction. This is not a final status, journals can be reversed if there is an error.

activity_created	Non-trade activity has been created for journal (JNLC v2-only).

rejected	Journal rejected. Please try again.

canceled	Journal canceled. This is a **FINAL** status.

refused	Journal refused. Please try again.

deleted	Journal deleted. This is a **FINAL** status.

correct	Journal is corrected. Previously executed journal is cancelled and a new journal is corrected amount is created. This is a **FINAL** status.

<h2 id="tocS_KYCResults">KYCResults</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemakycresults"></a>
<a id="schema_KYCResults"></a>
<a id="tocSkycresults"></a>
<a id="tocskycresults"></a>

```json
{
  "accept": null,
  "additional_information": "string",
  "indeterminate": null,
  "reject": null,
  "summary": "string"
}
```

Holds information about the result of KYC.

`accept`, `indeterminate`, and `reject` are nullable sets represented as objects. Each property name is a KYC reason identifier, and every property value is always an empty object (`{}`) carrying no nested data. For example:

```json
{
  "IDENTITY_VERIFICATION": {},
  "WATCHLIST_HIT": {}
}
```

Interpret each reason together with its enclosing result category and `additional_information`.

Documented reason identifiers:
- `IDENTITY_VERIFICATION`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's identity.
- `TAX_IDENTIFICATION`: A tax identification document is required to verify the account owner's tax identification number.
- `ADDRESS_VERIFICATION`: Additional documentation, such as a government-issued ID or statement, may be required to verify the account owner's residential address.
- `DATE_OF_BIRTH`: A government-issued identity document is required to verify the account owner's date of birth.
- `SELFIE_VERIFICATION`: A live selfie of the account owner is required to verify identity.
- `PEP`: The account owner disclosed politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.
- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member is politically exposed, and additional information may be required.
- `CONTROL_PERSON`: Additional company information may be required because the account owner disclosed a control position.
- `AFFILIATED`: Additional firm information may be required because the account owner disclosed an affiliation with FINRA or an exchange.
- `VISA_TYPE_OTHER`: The account owner's visa type and expiration date may be required because the submitted visa type was "other."
- `W8BEN_CORRECTION`: A new W-8BEN with corrected identifying information is required.
- `COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of tax residence or legal residence is not supported for this account.
- `WATCHLIST_HIT`: Watchlist screening returned a result that requires further review; no action is needed from the account owner unless separately requested.
- `OTHER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message describing what is required from the account owner.
- `OTHER_PARTNER`: See `additional_information` for a custom message intended for the Broker API partner.
- `CITIZENSHIP_COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED`: The account owner's country of citizenship is not supported for this account.
- `DIFFERING_COUNTRY`: A submitted identity document was issued by a country different from the account owner's country of tax residence.
- `WL_PEP_SCREENING`: Watchlist screening returned a result related to possible political exposure.
- `WL_LEGAL_REGULATORY_WARNING`: Watchlist screening returned a legal or regulatory warning result.
- `UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE`: The account owner does not meet the minimum age requirement for this account.
- `PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.
- `FAMILY_MEMBER_PEP_FOREIGN`: The account owner disclosed that an immediate family member has foreign politically exposed person status, and additional information may be required.
- `DISCRETIONARY`: The account is designated for discretionary trading by a registered investment adviser and requires review.
- `HIO`: Additional information and a declaration form may be required because the account owner disclosed being the head of an international organization.
- `INTERNAL_CHECK`: A non-specific account-opening check contributed to the KYC outcome; no more specific reason is available.
- `compromised_document`: The identity document check indicated that the document may be compromised.
- `data_comparison`: Data extracted from the identity document did not pass comparison checks and requires review.
- `image_integrity`: A document or selfie image did not pass image-integrity checks and requires review.

The set of reason identifiers is extensible, so integrations must tolerate and preserve unrecognized values.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accept|[KYCResultTypeSet](#schemakycresulttypeset)|false|none|A nullable set of KYC reason identifiers represented as property names with empty object values. See `KYCResults` for documented identifiers and interpretation guidance.|
|additional_information|string|false|none|Used to display a custom message.|
|indeterminate|[KYCResultTypeSet](#schemakycresulttypeset)|false|none|A nullable set of KYC reason identifiers represented as property names with empty object values. See `KYCResults` for documented identifiers and interpretation guidance.|
|reject|[KYCResultTypeSet](#schemakycresulttypeset)|false|none|A nullable set of KYC reason identifiers represented as property names with empty object values. See `KYCResults` for documented identifiers and interpretation guidance.|
|summary|string|false|none|Either `pass` or `fail`. Used to indicate if KYC has completed and passed or not. This field is used for internal purposes only.|

**SPD**: Substitute Payment In Lieu Of Dividend<br><br>- **FEE**: Fee-related activity sub-types:<br>  - **REG**: Regulatory Fee<br>  - **TAF**: Trading Activity Fee<br>  - **LCT**: Local Currency Trading Fee<br>  - **ORF**: Options Regulatory Fee<br>  - **OCC**: Options Clearing Corporation Fee<br>  - **NRC**: Non-Retail Commission Fee<br>  - **NRV**: Non-Retail Venue Fee<br>  - **COM**: Commission<br>  - **CAT**: Consolidated Audit Trail Fee<br><br>- **INT**: Interest-related activity sub-types:<br>  - **MGN**: Margin Interest<br>  - **CDT**: Credit Interest<br>  - **SWP**: Sweep Interest<br>  - **QII**: Qualified Interest<br>  - **FI**: Fixed Income Interest (coupon or accrued)<br><br>- **MA**: Merger and Acquisition activity sub-types:<br>  - **CMA**: Cash Merger<br>  - **SMA**: Stock Merger<br>  - **SCMA**: Stock & Cash Merger<br><br>- **NC**: Name Change activity sub types<br>  - **SNC**: Symbol Name Change<br>  - **CNC**: CUSIP Name Change<br>  - **SCNC**: Symbol & CUSIP Name Change<br><br>- **OPCA**: Option Corporate Action activity sub-types:<br>  - **DIV.CDIV**: Cash Dividend<br>  - **DIV.ROC**: Return of Capital<br>  - **DIV.SDIV**: Stock Dividend<br>  - **MA.CMA**: Cash Merger<br>  - **MA.SMA**: Stock Merger<br>  - **MA.SCMA**: Stock & Cash Merger<br>  - **NC.CNC**: CUSIP Name Change<br>  - **NC.SNC**: Symbol Name Change<br>  - **NC.SCNC**: Symbol & CUSIP Name Change<br>  - **SPIN**: Spin-off<br>  - **SPLIT.FSPLIT**: Forward Stock Split<br>  - **SPLIT.RSPLIT**: Reverse Stock Split<br>  - **SPLIT.USPLIT**: Unit Split<br><br>- **REO**: Reorganization activity sub-types:<br>  - **REOS**: Stock only (1 or more stock legs)<br>  - **REOC**: Cash only (one cash leg)<br>  - **REOSC**: Stock and cash<br><br>- **REORG**: Activity sub-types:<br>  - **WRM**: Worthless Removal<br><br>- **SPLIT**: Stock Split activity sub-types:<br>  - **FSPLIT**: Forward Stock Split<br>  - **RSPLIT**: Reverse Stock Split<br>  - **USPLIT**: Unit Split<br><br>- **VOF**: Voluntary Offering activity sub-types:<br>  - **VTND**: Tender Offer<br>  - **VWRT**: Warrant Exercise<br>  - **VRGT**: Rights Offer<br>  - **VEXH**: Exchange Offer<br><br>- **WH**: Withholding activity sub-types:<br>  - **SWH**: State Withholding<br>  - **FWH**: Federal Withholding<br>  - **SLWH**: Sales Withholding|

|---|---|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|close_price|string|false|none|The close price of the option contract.|
|close_price_date|string(date)|false|none|The date of the close price data.|
|deliverables|[[OptionDeliverable](#schemaoptiondeliverable)]|false|none|Represents the deliverables tied to the option contract. While standard contracts entail a single deliverable, non-standard ones can encompass multiple deliverables, each potentially customized with distinct parameters.<br>This array is included in the list contracts response only if the query parameter show_deliverables=true is provided.<br>|
|expiration_date|string(date)|true|none|The expiration date of the option contract.|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the option contract.|
|multiplier|string|true|none|The multiplier of the option contract is crucial for calculating both the trade premium and the extended strike price. In standard contracts, the multiplier is always set to 100.<br>For instance, if a contract is traded at $1.50 and the multiplier is 100, the total amount debited when buying the contract would be $150.00.<br>Similarly, when exercising a call contract, the total cost will be equal to the strike price times the multiplier.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the option contract.|
|open_interest|string|false|none|The open interest of the option contract.|
|open_interest_date|string(date)|false|none|The date of the open interest data.|
|ppind|boolean|true|none|The ppind (Penny Program Indicator) field indicates whether an option contract is eligible for penny price increments,<br>with `true` meaning it is part of the Penny Program and `false` meaning it is not.|
|root_symbol|string|false|none|The root symbol of the option contract.|
|size|string|true|none|Represents the number of underlying shares to be delivered in case the contract is exercised/assigned. For standard contracts, this is always 100.<br>This field should **not** be used as a multiplier, specially for non-standard contracts.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the option contract.|
|strike_price|string|true|none|The strike price of the option contract.|
|style|string|true|none|The style of the option contract.|
|symbol|string|true|none|The symbol representing the option contract.|
|tradable|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the option contract is tradable.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the option contract.|
|underlying_asset_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the underlying asset.|
|underlying_symbol|string|true|none|The underlying symbol of the option contract.|

|status|inactive|
|style|american|
|style|european|
|type|call|
|type|put|

  "asset_id": "b0b6dd9d-8b9b-48a9-ba46-b9d54906e415",
  "delayed_settlement": false,
  "settlement_method": "CCC",
  "settlement_type": "T+2",
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "type": "equity"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allocation_percentage|string|true|none|Cost allocation percentage of the deliverable.<br>This is used to determine the cost basis of the equity shares received from the exercise, specially for non-standard contracts with multiple deliverables.<br>|
|amount|string|true|none|The deliverable amount. For cash deliverables, this is the cash amount.<br>For standard contract, this is always 100.<br>When deliverable settlement is delayed and the amount is not yet determined, this value is "0" and delayed_settlement is true.<br>|
|asset_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the deliverable asset. For standard contracts, this is equivalent to underlying_asset_id of the contracts.<br>This field is not returned for cash deliverables.<br>|
|delayed_settlement|boolean|true|none|If true, the settlement of the deliverable will be delayed.<br>For instance, in the event of a contract with a delayed deliverable being exercised, both the availability of the deliverable and its settlement may be postponed beyond the typical timeframe.<br>|
|settlement_method|string|true|none|Indicates the settlement method that will be used:<br>- **BTOB**: Broker to Broker<br>- **CADF**: Cash Difference<br>- **CAFX**: Cash Fixed<br>- **CCC**: Correspondent Clearing Corp<br>|
|settlement_type|string|true|none|Indicates when the deliverable will be settled if the contract is exercised/assigned.<br>|
|symbol|string|true|none|Symbol of the deliverable. For standard contracts, this is equivalent to the underlying symbol of the contract.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|Type of deliverable, indicating whether it's cash or equity. For standard contracts, it is always "equity".<br>|

|settlement_type|T+1|
|settlement_type|T+2|
|settlement_type|T+3|
|settlement_type|T+4|
|settlement_type|T+5|
|type|cash|
|type|equity|

|swap_rate|string|false|none|Swap rate is the exchange rate (without mark-up) used to convert the price into local currency or crypto asset|

|time_in_force|[TimeInForce](#schematimeinforce)|false|none|The Time-In-Force values supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. Here is a breakdown of the supported TIFs for each specific security type:<br>- Equity trading: day, gtc, opg, cls, ioc, fok.<br>- Options trading: day, gtc.<br>- Crypto trading: gtc, ioc.<br><br>Below are the descriptions of each TIF:<br>- day:<br>  A day order is eligible for execution only on the day it is live. By default, the order is only valid during Regular Trading Hours (9:30am - 4:00pm ET). If unfilled after the closing auction, it is automatically canceled. If submitted after the close, it is queued and submitted the following trading day. However, if marked as eligible for extended hours, the order can also execute during supported extended hours.<br><br>- gtc:<br>  The order is good until canceled. Non-marketable GTC limit orders are subject to price adjustments to offset corporate actions affecting the issue. We do not currently support Do Not Reduce (DNR) orders to opt out of such price adjustments.<br><br>- opg:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on open" (MOO) and "limit on open" (LOO) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market opening auction. Any unfilled orders after the open will be cancelled. OPG orders submitted after 9:28am but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. OPG orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's opening auction. On open/on close orders are routed to the primary exchange. Such orders do not necessarily execute exactly at 9:30am / 4:00pm ET but execute per the exchange's auction rules.<br><br>- cls:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on close" (MOC) and "limit on close" (LOC) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market closing auction. Any unfilled orders after the close will be cancelled. CLS orders submitted after 3:50pm but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. CLS orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's closing auction.<br><br>- ioc:<br>  An Immediate Or Cancel (IOC) order requires all or part of the order to be executed immediately. Any unfilled portion of the order is canceled. Most market makers who receive IOC orders will attempt to fill the order on a principal basis only, and cancel any unfilled balance. On occasion, this can result in the entire order being cancelled if the market maker does not have any existing inventory of the security in question.<br><br>- fok:<br>  A Fill or Kill (FOK) order is only executed if the entire order quantity can be filled, otherwise the order is canceled.|

|trail_price|string \| null(decimal)|false|none|The dollar value away from the high water mark for trailing stop orders.|
|type|[OrderType](#schemaordertype)|false|none|The order types supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. The following provides a comprehensive breakdown of the supported order types for each category:<br> - Equity trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit, trailing_stop.<br> - Options trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit.<br> - Options Multileg trading: market, limit.<br> - Crypto trading: market, limit, stop_limit.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time of most recent change to the order|
|usd|object|false|none|Nested object to encompass the USD equivalent fields for the local currency fields|

|replaces|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|The order ID that this order replaces. (Can be null)|
|settlement_currency|string|false|none|Settlement currency of the order. Omitted when the order has none.|
|side|[OrderSide](#schemaorderside)|false|none|Represents what side of the transaction an order was on. Required for all order classes except for `mleg`.|
|status|[OrderStatus](#schemaorderstatus)|false|none|none|
|stop_price|string \| null(decimal)|false|none|Stop price|
|submitted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time the order was submitted for execution or, if not yet submitted the created_at time. Because orders are submitted for execution asynchronous to database updates, at times this may be after the created_at time.|
|swap_fee_bps|string|false|none|Fee in basis points on top swap rate charged by the correspondent on every order|
|swap_rate|string|false|none|Swap rate is the exchange rate (without mark-up) used to convert the price into local currency or crypto asset|
|symbol|string|true|none|The asset symbol|
|time_in_force|[TimeInForce](#schematimeinforce)|false|none|The Time-In-Force values supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. Here is a breakdown of the supported TIFs for each specific security type:<br>- Equity trading: day, gtc, opg, cls, ioc, fok.<br>- Options trading: day, gtc.<br>- Crypto trading: gtc, ioc.<br><br>Below are the descriptions of each TIF:<br>- day:<br>  A day order is eligible for execution only on the day it is live. By default, the order is only valid during Regular Trading Hours (9:30am - 4:00pm ET). If unfilled after the closing auction, it is automatically canceled. If submitted after the close, it is queued and submitted the following trading day. However, if marked as eligible for extended hours, the order can also execute during supported extended hours.<br><br>- gtc:<br>  The order is good until canceled. Non-marketable GTC limit orders are subject to price adjustments to offset corporate actions affecting the issue. We do not currently support Do Not Reduce (DNR) orders to opt out of such price adjustments.<br><br>- opg:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on open" (MOO) and "limit on open" (LOO) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market opening auction. Any unfilled orders after the open will be cancelled. OPG orders submitted after 9:28am but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. OPG orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's opening auction. On open/on close orders are routed to the primary exchange. Such orders do not necessarily execute exactly at 9:30am / 4:00pm ET but execute per the exchange's auction rules.<br><br>- cls:<br>  Use this TIF with a market/limit order type to submit "market on close" (MOC) and "limit on close" (LOC) orders. This order is eligible to execute only in the market closing auction. Any unfilled orders after the close will be cancelled. CLS orders submitted after 3:50pm but before 7:00pm ET will be rejected. CLS orders submitted after 7:00pm will be queued and routed to the following day's closing auction.<br><br>- ioc:<br>  An Immediate Or Cancel (IOC) order requires all or part of the order to be executed immediately. Any unfilled portion of the order is canceled. Most market makers who receive IOC orders will attempt to fill the order on a principal basis only, and cancel any unfilled balance. On occasion, this can result in the entire order being cancelled if the market maker does not have any existing inventory of the security in question.<br><br>- fok:<br>  A Fill or Kill (FOK) order is only executed if the entire order quantity can be filled, otherwise the order is canceled.|
|trail_percent|string \| null(decimal)|false|none|The percent value away from the high water mark for trailing stop orders.|
|trail_price|string \| null(decimal)|false|none|The dollar value away from the high water mark for trailing stop orders.|
|type|[OrderType](#schemaordertype)|false|none|The order types supported by Alpaca vary based on the order's security type. The following provides a comprehensive breakdown of the supported order types for each category:<br> - Equity trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit, trailing_stop.<br> - Options trading: market, limit, stop, stop_limit.<br> - Options Multileg trading: market, limit.<br> - Crypto trading: market, limit, stop_limit.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time of most recent change to the order|
|usd|object|false|none|Nested object to encompass the USD equivalent fields for the local currency fields|

<h2 id="tocS_PortfolioRunStatus">PortfolioRunStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaportfoliorunstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_PortfolioRunStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSportfoliorunstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsportfoliorunstatus"></a>

```json
"QUEUED"
```

|       Status       | Final |                                 Represented State                                |                                                         Notes                                                        |
|:------------------:|:-----:|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|
| QUEUED             | No    | The run has been queued, waiting for our system to process it.                   | Runs only executed when the US market is open and there's at least 15 minutes before the market closes.              |
| IN_PROGRESS        | No    | Portfolio adjustment is in progress.                                             |                                                                                                                      |
| CANCELED           | Yes, unless the run was already placing orders | Portfolio run canceled before it started, or while waiting to be retried | If the run was already placing orders, those orders are not canceled and the run's final status can replace CANCELED. |
| CANCELED_MID_RUN   | Yes   | Portfolio run canceled while executing.                                          | The portfolio's state is in between the pre-run and post-run state, manual remediation or job re-run is recommended. |
| ERROR              | Yes   | There was an error while rebalancing the portfolio.                              | The portfolio's state is in between the pre-run and post-run state, manual remediation or job re-run is recommended. |
| TIMEOUT            | Yes   | A timeout occurred while rebalancing the portfolio.                               | The portfolio's state is in between the pre-run and post-run state, manual remediation or job re-run is recommended. |
| COMPLETED_ADJUSTED | Yes   | The portfolio has been adjusted                                                  | The adjustments have been prepared, but the run details haven't yet updated with the list of resulting orders        |
| COMPLETED_SUCCESS  | Yes   | The portfolio has been adjusted, run status updated                              |                                                                                                                      |

<h2 id="tocS_RebalancingConditions">RebalancingConditions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarebalancingconditions"></a>
<a id="schema_RebalancingConditions"></a>

<a id="tocsrebalancingconditions"></a>

```json
{
  "day": "string",
  "percent": "string",
  "sub_type": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|day|string|false|none|Used to specify the rebalancing day for conditions of type = calendar. Only permitted and required for type = calendar. In scenarios when the specified day aligns to a non-trading day, the rebalance will be triggered on the preceding trading day. For type= annually, the value must be passed in MM-DD format. If 02-29 is specified and the current year is not a leap year, the rebalance will occur on the trading day preceding 2/29. For type= quarterly and monthly the value must be an integer between 1 and 31 inclusive. This represents the day of month. For quarterly, rebalancing will trigger on this day in January, March, June, and December. If the specified day is non-existent for the month then the rebalancing will trigger on the preceding trading day. For type = weekly, permitted values are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.|
|percent|string|false|none|Must be a positive value, up to two decimal places. Only permitted and required for type = drift_band. This is the max allowable drift percent from any target weight (+/-)|
|sub_type|string|false|none|For type = drift_band: absolute or relative. For type = calendar: weekly,monthly, quarterly or annually. For type = on_portfolio_update: there is no subtype|
|type|string|false|none|Possible values of drift_band, calendar or on_portfolio_update|

  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

```

A settlement response, either from creation or retrieval

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additional_info|string|false|none|none|
|asset_class|[JITAssetClass](#schemajitassetclass)|false|none|Values:<br> * `crypto`: Used to identify a crypto only account<br> * `us_equity`: Used to identify an account that trades US equities, or both crypto and<br>  US equities.<br>|
|completed_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|currency|string|false|none|The currency of the settlement. Only applicable to JIT settlements.<br>|
|id|string(uuid)|true|none|none|
|interest_amount|string(decimal)|false|none|The total interest amount accrued on the transfers included in this settlement. Only applicable for instant funding settlements.<br>|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for failure, if applicable<br>|
|source_account_number|string|false|none|none|
|status|[SettlementStatus](#schemasettlementstatus)|true|none|Values:<br> * `PENDING`: Created and waiting to be processed<br> * `AWAITING_ADDITIONAL_FUNDS`: Waiting for additional funds to be deposited<br> * `COMPLETED`: All transactions are reconciled<br> * `FAILED`: Attempt to process this settlement has failed. If this is observed<br>  additional remittance information may be required, or one of the transfers being settled<br>  accrued additional interest since the settlement was created.<br>|
|total_amount|string(decimal)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|asset_class|crypto|
|asset_class|us_equity|
|status|PENDING|
|status|AWAITING_ADDITIONAL_FUNDS|
|status|COMPLETED|
|status|FAILED|

<h2 id="tocS_SettlementStatus">SettlementStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasettlementstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_SettlementStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSsettlementstatus"></a>
<a id="tocssettlementstatus"></a>

```json
"PENDING"
```

Values:
 * `PENDING`: Created and waiting to be processed
 * `AWAITING_ADDITIONAL_FUNDS`: Waiting for additional funds to be deposited
 * `COMPLETED`: All transactions are reconciled
 * `FAILED`: Attempt to process this settlement has failed. If this is observed
  additional remittance information may be required, or one of the transfers being settled
  accrued additional interest since the settlement was created.
